title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
abstract: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.

title_cn: KaliBench：基于 Kali Linux 的细粒度网络安全工具使用基准，附免运行时可验证奖励
abstract_cn: LLM 日益应用于网络安全工作流，被期望把分析师意图转化为工具调用。但现有评估聚焦知识型测评或端到端智能体任务，未直接测量 LLM 为真实网络安全工具生成可执行命令的能力。该缺口关键：网络安全运维依赖严格的命令行接口（CLI），轻微的语法错误、错误的旗标-值绑定或参数乱序即可使执行失效。我们提出 KaliBench，一个 Kali Linux 上自然语言到 CLI 翻译的细粒度基准与数据集：8,504 个查询-命令对，覆盖 1,642 个工具、23 个能力维度与 5 个安全阶段。KaliBench 经由手稿锚定管线构建，带确定性规范化与别名感知评估，实现对工具选择与参数构造的精确可复现评估。为确保语义正确与实际可执行，我们开发多阶段验证管线，结合基于 LLM 的验证、沙箱终端执行与人在回路精化。基于这些细粒度确定性信号，KaliBench 进一步为训练提供免运行时的可验证奖励。在三种评估模式与 24 个通用及安全特化开源权重模型配置上，没有任何开放权重模型在无限制设置下超过 42% 的精确命令准确率，凸显无显式工具提示时精确 CLI 网络安全工具使用的难度。我们进一步表明，监督微调与以 KaliBench 可验证奖励的强化学习显著改进一个 8B 模型并达到与 685B MoE 模型相当的性能。（NeurIPS 2026 数据集与基准轨道接收）
summary_cn: 提出 NL→CLI 翻译基准 KaliBench：8,504 对、1,642 工具、23 维度、5 阶段，LLM 验证+沙箱执行+人工精化校验；24 个开源模型配置无一超过 42% 精确命令准确率，SFT+RLVR 使 8B 模型达到 685B MoE 水平。
objective_summary: 构建手稿锚定的 Kali 工具 NL→CLI 基准与多阶段验证管线，评测 24 个开源模型配置的工具选择与参数构造准确率，并示范用可验证奖励做 SFT/RL 训练。
evidence_note: NeurIPS 2026 数据集与基准轨道接收；8,504 对多阶段验证（沙箱实测）、24 模型配置、训练对照（8B 对 685B）；确定性评估保证可复现。
novelty_note: 填补「细粒度 CLI 翻译」评估缺口：既有评测限于知识型或端到端任务，本基准给出工具选择与参数构造的确定性测量并支持训练奖励。
scope: 结论适用于 Kali Linux 工具生态与英文查询的 NL→CLI 任务；评估以命令精确匹配+别名为口径；对多步攻击链编排与交互式工具会话未覆盖。
limitations: 单命令翻译，不含长程任务规划；手稿锚定可能偏向主流工具用法；沙箱验证的覆盖依赖环境配置。

title: Quantum Advantage for Two-Party Differential Privacy
abstract: We introduce information-theoretically private quantum protocols for two-party Hamming distance when both parties must output the same estimate. Classically, for input length $n$, information-theoretic protocols require $\Omega(\sqrt{n})$ error under pure differential privacy and $\Omega(\sqrt{n}/\log n)$ error under strong approximate differential privacy, whereas computational security permits $O(1)$ error. In Klauck's honest, nonpreemptive, message-preserving model, we give an $O(n)$-communication quantum protocol with pure $\varepsilon$ quantum differential privacy (QDP) and expected error at most $\frac{2}{\sinh \varepsilon}+\gamma$, for every $\gamma>0$. For approximate $(\varepsilon, \delta)$ QDP, an exact hockey-stick divergence calculation yields strictly smaller error, while preserving the $O(1)$-versus-$\Omega(\sqrt{n}/\log n)$ separation for $\delta=o(1/n)$. Thus, quantum communication achieves $O(1)$ information-theoretic error, matching the accuracy available classically only under computational assumptions. The main construction uses a guarded coherent round trip and an equal-Gram rigidity principle that prevents an honest player from retaining input-dependent complementary information. We separate this model from weaker prescribed-channel privacy, which already admits an exact classical realization, and from fully retention-robust security, against which measurement-and-abort attacks remain possible. Therefore, we identify preservation of non-orthogonal quantum messages as a resource for privacy.

title_cn: 两方差分隐私的量子优势
abstract_cn: 我们为两方汉明距离引入信息论隐私的量子协议，双方必须输出相同估计。经典地，对输入长度 n，信息论协议在纯差分隐私下需要 Ω(√n) 误差，在强近似差分隐私下需要 Ω(√n/log n) 误差，而计算安全允许 O(1) 误差。在 Klauck 的诚实、非抢占、消息保持模型中，我们给出 O(n) 通信的量子协议，具有纯 ε 量子差分隐私（QDP），对每个 γ>0 期望误差至多 2/sinh ε + γ。对近似 (ε,δ) QDP，精确的曲棍球杆散度计算给出严格更小的误差，同时在 δ=o(1/n) 下保持 O(1) 对 Ω(√n/log n) 的分离。因此，量子通信达成 O(1) 的信息论误差——匹配经典情形仅在计算假设下可得的精度。主构造使用受守护的相干往返与等 Gram 刚性原理，阻止诚实方保留输入依赖的互补信息。我们把该模型与较弱的规定信道隐私（已有精确经典实现）以及完全保持鲁棒的安全（测量即中止攻击仍可能）分离。因此我们把「非正交量子消息的保持」确认为一种隐私资源。
summary_cn: 给出两方汉明距离的量子 DP 协议：O(n) 通信、纯 ε-QDP 下期望误差 O(1)，分离经典信息论 Ω(√n)（近似 DP Ω(√n/log n)）与计算安全的差距；核心为相干往返守护与等 Gram 刚性。
objective_summary: 构造两方汉明距离的量子差分隐私协议并证明其在纯/近似 QDP 下的 O(1) 误差，与经典信息论下界分离，并界定模型假设。
evidence_note: 信息论分离（O(1) vs Ω(√n/log n)）的完整证明 + 模型间分离的细致刻画；理论工作以紧致分离为据。
novelty_note: 确立「量子消息保持」作为隐私资源并给出两方差分隐私的量子-经典分离；该问题设定在量子信息与隐私交叉属较新。
scope: 结论在 Klauck 的诚实、非抢占、消息保持模型内成立；较弱或更强隐私模型已有经典或否定结果；不涉及物理实现噪声。
limitations: 消息保持假设排除测量-中止等攻击，现实协议需额外防护；O(n) 通信的常数与优化未给出；未处理多方推广。

title: Time-space lower bounds for breaking quantum cryptography
abstract: We prove near-optimal time-space lower bounds for breaking quantum cryptography in the random oracle model. Specifically, we show that a $T$-query adversary with $S$ qubits of non-uniform advice can recover a random key $k$ from the $n$-qubit binary phase state $|\psi_k\rangle \propto \sum_{x} R(k,x) |x\rangle$ with probability at most $O(\frac{T^2 + \sqrt{ST}}{N})$ for $N=2^n$. In contrast, the best known bound for post-quantum one-way functions is $O(\frac{T^2 + ST}{N})$, with a trivial attack at $S = N$. This demonstrates a new advantage of quantum cryptography over classical cryptography: $n$ qubits of communication suffice for security against preprocessing attacks with space up to $N^2$ rather than $N$. Our methodology is simple: express the optimal preprocessing attack as the operator norm of a random matrix, and bound this value in expectation over the random oracle via the trace-moment method. These trace moments have a natural interpretation using compressed oracles [Zhandry, Crypto 2019], which we then analyze. This can be viewed as a simplification and generalization of the approach of Liu [Eurocrypt 2023] for proving time-space tradeoffs for breaking post-quantum cryptography. We also prove the following results: (1) We tighten Liu's analysis of post-quantum PRGs in QROM, achieving a distinguishing advantage bound of $O(\frac{T^2}N + \sqrt{\frac{ST}N})$. (2) For unitary synthesis, we extend the one-query lower bound of Lombardi-Ma-Wright [STOC 2024] to hold against adversaries that can make one arbitrary function query along with polynomially many (adaptive) queries to the random oracle, either before or after the function query. This also interprets the original LMW24 result in terms of compressed oracles. (3) Finally, we prove a tight $O(\frac{\sqrt{S}}N)$ bound for the pseudorandomness of random binary phase states against space $S$ distinguishers.
title_cn: 破解量子密码的时空下界
abstract_cn: 我们在随机预言机模型中证明破解量子密码的近最优时空下界。具体地：一个 T 次查询、带 S 比特非均匀建议的对手，从 n 比特二进制相位态 |ψ_k⟩ ∝ Σ_x R(k,x)|x⟩ 恢复随机密钥 k 的概率至多为 O((T²+√(ST))/N)，N=2ⁿ。相比之下，后量子单向函数的已知最佳界为 O((T²+ST)/N)，且在 S=N 处有平凡攻击。这展示了量子密码相对经典密码的新优势：n 比特通信足以抵抗空间至多 N²（而非 N）的预处理攻击。方法简单：把最优预处理攻击表示为随机矩阵的算子范数，并用迹矩方法在随机预言机上取期望界定该值；这些迹矩经由压缩预言机[Zhandry, Crypto 2019]获得自然解释。这可视为对 Liu（Eurocrypt 2023）证明后量子密码时空权衡方法的简化与推广。我们还证明：（1）收紧 Liu 对 QROM 中后量子 PRG 的分析，达到 O(T²/N+√(ST/N)) 的区分优势界；（2）对幺正合成，把 Lombardi–Ma–Wright[STOC 2024] 的单查询下界扩展到可在函数查询前后做任意一次函数查询与多项次自适应预言机查询的对手，并把原结果用压缩预言机重新诠释；（3）对随机二进制相位态抗空间 S 区分者的伪随机性，证明紧的 O(√S/N) 界。
summary_cn: 在随机预言机模型证明：T 查询 S 建议的对手恢复二进制相位态密钥的概率至多 O((T²+√(ST))/N)，故 n 量子比特可抗空间至多 N² 的预处理攻击（经典密码为 N），并附 QROM PRG、幺正合成等配套结果。
objective_summary: 证明随机预言机下破解二进制相位态类量子密码的时空下界，建立相对经典/后量子原语的预处理抗性分离，并用压缩预言机统一推导多个配套界。
evidence_note: 近最优（含紧界 O(√S/N)）的下界证明与统一方法论；理论工作以定理完备性与紧致性为据。
novelty_note: 给出量子密码相对预处理攻击的结构性优势分离（空间抗性 N² 对 N），并把既有结果（Liu、LMW）统一收紧。
scope: 结论限于随机预言机模型与二进制相位态类构造；「优势」为渐近界而非具体参数建议；不覆盖量子建议的对手设定。
limitations: 下界依赖随机预言机理想化；相位态构造到具体方案的映射未展开；预处理模型的建议获取方式简化。

title: On the pseudorandomness of simple quantum processes
abstract: Can simple processes appear highly complex? Gowers (Comb. Prob. Comp. '96) conjectured that repeatedly composing local random reversible operations can yield global permutations that are indistinguishable from random. In this work, we study the unitary quantum analog of this question, in an attempt to make new progress on this longstanding conjecture. Our first result shows that statistical moment matching in the form of unitary designs does not generically lead to pseudorandomness---even for the simplest quantum processes: for every fixed $t$, we give an efficiently samplable family $\{\nu_n\}_n$ of distributions on one- and two-qubit gates such that, after $T=O_t(n^2\log^2 n)$ independent steps, the resulting $n$-qubit ensemble is an approximate unitary $t$-design with negligible error $\exp(-\Omega(\log^2 n))$, yet an efficient quantum algorithm distinguishes it from random using only $O_t(\log^2 n)$ queries. This refutes the unitary analog of the Hoory--Magen--Myers--Rackoff conjecture (ICALP '04) for permutations. Our second result is a stronger separation between unitary designs and pseudorandom unitaries at polynomially bounded moments; our counterexample, however, requires highly structured ensembles, in contrast with the simple local walks from before. This suggests caution when using unitary designs to model information scrambling in black-hole physics, as even maximally scrambled systems can exhibit structure which is accessible to efficient experiments. Motivated by these findings, we then propose new conjectures for how pseudorandomness can plausibly emerge within simple quantum processes, such as random quantum circuits.
title_cn: 论简单量子过程的伪随机性
abstract_cn: 简单过程能显得高度复杂吗？Gowers（Comb. Prob. Comp. '96）猜想：反复复合局部随机可逆操作可以产生与随机置换不可区分的全局置换。本工作研究该问题的幺正量子类比，试图为这一长期猜想取得新进展。第一个结果表明：以幺正设计形式出现的统计矩匹配一般不导致伪随机性——即使对最简单的量子过程：对每个固定 t，我们给出单/双比特门上的高效可采样分布族 {ν_n}，使在 T=O_t(n²log²n) 步独立复合后，所得 n 比特系综是以可忽略误差 exp(−Ω(log²n)) 的近似幺正 t-设计，但一个高效量子算法仅需 O_t(log²n) 次查询即可将其与随机区分。这反驳了置换上 Hoory–Magen–Myers–Rackoff 猜想（ICALP '04）的幺正类比。第二个结果在多项式有界矩下给出幺正设计与伪随机幺正间更强的分离；但该反例需要高度结构化的系综，与前面的简单局部游走形成对照。这提示以幺正设计建模黑洞物理中的信息加扰时需谨慎——即使最大加扰的系统也可能展现高效实验可及的结构。受这些发现启发，我们为伪随机性如何在简单量子过程（如随机量子电路）中出现提出新猜想。
summary_cn: 构造单/双比特门游走：T=O(n²log²n) 步后为近似 t-设计却被 O(log²n) 次查询的量子算法区分，反驳 HMMR 猜想的幺正类比，并在多项式矩下给出设计 vs 伪随机幺正的更强分离。
objective_summary: 研究局部随机量子过程的伪随机性，构造近似幺正设计却可高效区分的反例并给出设计-伪随机分离，据此提出新猜想。
evidence_note: 显式可采样反例构造与查询复杂度分离证明；理论结果完备并附带物理诠释（黑洞信息加扰）。
novelty_note: 对长期猜想的幺正类比给出否定回答并澄清「设计≠伪随机」的边界，提出新的可行猜想方向；对量子密码与物理交叉有指导意义。
scope: 结论针对固定 t 矩匹配与所构造门族；第二个分离依赖结构化系综；不否定随机量子电路本身的伪随机性猜想。
limitations: 反例门族为构造性选择，非「自然」局部游走；区分算法依赖 t-设计结构；新猜想未给出支持性证据。

title: Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints
abstract: Privacy-preserving machine learning presents significant deployment challenges on the cloud for intelligent systems with confidential data. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a compelling solution for secure computation, preserving data confidentiality of cloud computations. However, applying FHE to reinforcement learning (RL) requires replacing non-linear operations with polynomial approximations, which diverge catastrophically due to a unique recursive error phenomenon known as the Bellman drift. This article introduces the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), a stabilization framework designed to prevent polynomial approximation divergence in FHE-based deep RL. HAO adapts the zero-mean centering projection from advantage-based value estimation directly to temporal-difference (TD) targets. This linear projection annihilates the uniform state-value baseline that drives the Bellman drift, maintaining per-state action rankings while requiring zero additional non-linear multiplicative depth and avoiding expensive ciphertext bootstrapping. The proposed HAO framework was evaluated using a three-tier experimental methodology, including a tabular Markov Decision Process (MDP), an encrypted CartPole environment using real CKKS cryptographic operations, and a 20-node logistics routing benchmark with dense continuous features. The results demonstrate that the proposed HAO strictly bounds network pre-activations within the safe polynomial approximation domain. The proposed HAO RL agents achieved 0% boundary breaches across all random seeds used, whereas regularization alone (L2 weight decay and gradient clipping) breached the bound on 3 of 5 seeds and the unstabilized baseline did so in 83.8% of episodes. Finally, HAO agents improve optimal policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points in tabular domains and remain stable when DP-SGD-style Gaussian noise is added to the clipped gradients.
title_cn: 同态优势算子：在全同态加密约束下稳定强化学习
abstract_cn: 隐私保护的机器学习在云端为带机密数据的智能系统部署带来显著挑战。全同态加密（FHE）为安全计算提供诱人方案，保持云上计算的数据机密性。但把 FHE 用于强化学习（RL）需要用多项式近似替换非线性操作，这会因称为 Bellman 漂移的独特递归误差现象而灾难性发散。本文引入同态优势算子（HAO），一个为防止基于 FHE 的深度 RL 中多项式近似发散而设计的稳定化框架。HAO 把基于优势的价值估计中的零均值中心化投影直接适配到时序差分（TD）目标上。该线性投影消灭驱动 Bellman 漂移的一致状态值基线，维持逐状态动作排序，同时不增加任何额外的非线性乘法深度并避免昂贵的密文自举。所提 HAO 框架以三层实验方法论评估：表格 MDP、使用真实 CKKS 密码操作加密的 CartPole 环境、以及带稠密连续特征的 20 节点物流路由基准。结果表明 HAO 把网络预激活严格约束在安全多项式近似域内：HAO RL 智能体在所有随机种子上 0% 边界违背，而仅正则化（L2 权重衰减与梯度裁剪）在 5 个种子中的 3 个违背边界，未稳定化基线在 83.8% 的回合违背。最后，HAO 智能体在表格域把最优策略准确率提高 18.0 个百分点，并在向裁剪后梯度添加 DP-SGD 式高斯噪声时保持稳定。
summary_cn: 提出 HAO 线性投影消除 FHE-RL 的 Bellman 漂移：无需自举且零额外乘法深度，三层实验（表格 MDP/CKKS CartPole/物流路由）中 0% 边界违背对基线 83.8%，表格域最优策略准确率提升 18.0 个百分点。
objective_summary: 设计把优势中心化投影用于 TD 目标的 HAO 框架以稳定全同态加密下的深度 RL，并在表格 MDP、真实 CKKS 环境与路由基准上测量近似域违背率与策略性能。
evidence_note: 三层实验但规模小（表格、CartPole、20 节点路由）；单一方法内部对照，无外部方法对比；无统计检验。
novelty_note: 识别并命名 FHE-RL 的 Bellman 漂移现象、给出零深度代价的线性修复；FHE+RL 的组合已有探索，问题诊断为增量贡献。
scope: 结论适用于 CKKS 类近似同态加密上的价值基 RL；对策略梯度/PPO 类方法的适用性未验证；小规模环境的结论外推到大模型 RL 受限。
limitations: 实验环境规模小且非真实工作负载；未报告同态计算的实际时间开销；与已有 FHE-RL 稳定化尝试的比较缺失。

title: Can AI Oversight Be Zero Knowledge?
abstract: AI systems increasingly produce outputs from confidential data, such as a fitness-for-duty assessment from medical records or the predicted properties of a drug candidate from its secret structure. It is important to verify that such outputs are correct without revealing the underlying data. A recent line of work studies verification of AI outputs via interactive proofs and debate for oracle-aided computation, where correctness may depend on an oracle such as human judgment, a physical experiment, or the web. These works focus on verification by a verifier that runs much faster than the computation. However, such efficient verification is impossible for general oracle-aided computation, and these works therefore rely on additional assumptions. We focus instead on privacy: allowing the verifier to run in time polynomial in the computation, we ask whether interactive arguments for oracle-aided computation can be zero knowledge, so that the verifier learns nothing about the confidential data beyond the correctness of the output. We prove that, in general, they cannot. In the random oracle model, there are no zero-knowledge proofs for all oracle-aided computations, even if both the prover and the verifier are allowed to run much longer than the computation itself. The impossibility extends to debate, a canonical model for scalable oversight. On the positive side, we show that if the oracle attaches a cryptographic signature to each of its answers, then every oracle-aided computation can be verified in zero knowledge with an efficient prover and verifier, assuming only collision-resistant hash functions. Beyond privacy, this also gives an alternative approach to scalable oversight that relies neither on an honest opponent, as in debate, nor on the robustness of the computation, as in prior single-prover protocols.
title_cn: AI 监督可以是零知识的吗？
abstract_cn: AI 系统日益从机密数据产出结果，例如从医疗记录产出适岗评估、或从候选药物的保密结构预测其性质。在不泄露底层数据的前提下验证此类输出的正确性很重要。近期一条工作线研究经由交互式证明与辩论对「预言机辅助计算」的验证——正确性可能依赖人类判断、物理实验或网络等预言机。这些工作聚焦由运行远快于计算本身的验证者完成的验证。但对一般预言机辅助计算，这种高效验证不可能，因此这些工作依赖额外假设。我们转而聚焦隐私：允许验证者以计算的多项式时间运行，我们问：预言机辅助计算的交互式论证能否是零知识的——验证者除输出正确性外对机密数据一无所知。我们证明一般来说不能。在随机预言机模型中，不存在对所有预言机辅助计算的零知识证明，即使证明者与验证者都被允许运行远长于计算本身的时间。该不可能性扩展到辩论——可扩展监督的典范模型。积极方面，我们证明若预言机为其每个答案附加密码学签名，则每个预言机辅助计算都能在零知识下验证，证明者与验证者皆高效，仅需抗碰撞哈希函数。除隐私外，这也给出可扩展监督的另一条路径：既不依赖辩论中的诚实对手，也不依赖先前单证明者协议所依赖的计算鲁棒性。
summary_cn: 证明随机预言机模型中预言机辅助计算的零知识验证一般不可能（含辩论模型）；但若预言机为其答案附加密码签名，则仅凭抗碰撞哈希即可高效零知识验证任意此类计算，给出可扩展监督新路径。
objective_summary: 研究 AI 输出验证的零知识性：证明随机预言机模型下的一般不可能性并扩展到辩论，给出带签名预言机下的积极构造。
evidence_note: 不可能性定理+条件积极构造的完整理论结果，假设标准（随机预言机、抗碰撞哈希）；以证明完备性为据。
novelty_note: 把「监督的零知识性」确立为可判定问题并给出一般不可能性与绕开路径；连接零知识与可扩展 AI 监督的新问题形式化。
scope: 结论在随机预言机模型与签名预言机假设内成立；积极构造要求预言机侧配合签名；不涉及具体监督流水线的工程成本。
limitations: 签名预言机的现实部署（谁签、如何审计）未讨论；不可能性依赖随机预言机理想化；辩论扩展的具体参数未给出。

title: System-Level Optimization Beyond Cryptographic Kernels: An ML-KEM Case Study on Arm Cortex-M7
abstract: Recent work on embedded post-quantum cryptography has focused primarily on instruction-level optimization, including arithmetic-kernel improvements, assembly tuning, register allocation, and instruction scheduling. Using the Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM) on an Arm Cortex-M7 as a case study, we examine the additional gains available from memory-hierarchy utilization, tightly coupled memory placement, peripheral integration, clock configuration, and deterministic public-data reuse. The evaluation starts from a state-of-the-art SLOTHY-optimized implementation and covers all three ML-KEM parameter sets. Without modifying the cryptographic algorithm or standardized wire formats, the evaluated profiles without auxiliary public state reduce cycles by up to 2.5%. A selected public-data-reuse profile reduces encapsulation and decapsulation cycles by up to 74.6% and 58.8%, respectively. These results demonstrate that substantial deployment gains remain after arithmetic-kernel optimization and motivate a two-stage methodology that also examines the surrounding execution system.
comment: 22 pages and 4 figures. Extended version to the paper in the Proceedings of FPS-2026: 19th International Symposium on Foundations & Practice of Security
title_cn: 超越密码核的系统级优化：Arm Cortex-M7 上的 ML-KEM 案例研究
abstract_cn: 近期嵌入式后量子密码工作主要聚焦指令级优化，包括算术核改进、汇编调优、寄存器分配与指令调度。以 Arm Cortex-M7 上的模块格密钥封装机制（ML-KEM）为案例，我们考察来自存储层级利用、紧耦合存储器放置、外设集成、时钟配置与确定性公共数据复用的额外增益。评估从最先进的 SLOTHY 优化实现出发，覆盖全部三个 ML-KEM 参数集。在不修改密码算法或标准化线上格式的前提下，不含辅助公共状态的所评配置降低周期至多 2.5%；选定的公共数据复用配置把封装与解封装周期分别降低至多 74.6% 与 58.8%。这些结果表明在算术核优化之后仍有可观的部署增益，并促使采用同样审视周围执行系统的两阶段方法论。（FPS 2026 扩展版）
summary_cn: 以 Cortex-M7 上 ML-KEM 三参数集为案例，从 SLOTHY 最优实现出发考察系统级手段：常规配置再降周期至多 2.5%，公共数据复用配置使封装/解封装周期至多降 74.6%/58.8%（FPS 2026 扩展版）。
objective_summary: 在 Cortex-M7 上量化存储层级、TCM、外设、时钟与公共数据复用等系统级手段对 SLOTHY 优化 ML-KEM 的额外周期收益。
evidence_note: 从 SLOTHY 基线出发、覆盖三参数集的实测周期数据；单一 MCU 平台，无统计检验；对比基线单一。
novelty_note: 把嵌入式 PQC 优化焦点从算术核扩展到系统级并量化各项贡献，方法论对部署有直接指导；单项手段为已知工程实践的组合。
scope: 结论适用于 Cortex-M7 类 MCU 与 SLOTHY 优化基线；74.6%/58.8% 的复用收益伴随确定性公共数据的正确性与新鲜度管理责任；其他平台需重新评估。
limitations: 公共数据复用可能引入部署安全隐患（陈旧公共密钥），文中权衡需逐场景审视；未覆盖功耗与能量指标；仅一个 MCU 家族。

title: A Hybrid Approach to Malware Detection: Integrating Few-Shot Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning with Autoencoders
abstract: Ransomware has emerged as a major cybersecurity threat, with incidents increasing in frequency and impact across critical sectors. These attacks are typically launched through phishing emails, malicious downloads, or exploitation of software vulnerabilities to gain system access. Once inside, the malware encrypts files and demands a ransom, often in cryptocurrency, for the decryption key. Conventional detection methods often struggle with novel or scarce samples, leaving systems vulnerable. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid deep learning framework that combines an Autoencoder Feature Extractor (AFE) with a Model Agnostic Meta Learning (MAML) classifier for few shot malware detection. The AFE generates compact latent features that reduce noise and dimensionality, while the MAML classifier rapidly adapts to new threats using limited labeled data. Experiments conducted on the Ransomware Dataset 2024 demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework in binary classification tasks. Across one to fifty shot settings, the proposed model consistently achieves high accuracy, F1 score, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient values, maintaining reliable classification even under extreme scarcity. These results highlight the model's robustness and effectiveness in adapting to limited data scenarios, demonstrating the potential of combining feature extraction with meta learning to enhance resilience against malware, particularly in sectors such as healthcare, manufacturing, and public infrastructure, where cyberattacks can cause significant operational and financial disruption.
comment: Accepted at 2025 Cyber Awareness and Research Symposium (CARS). This is the author's accepted manuscript
title_cn: 恶意软件检测的混合方法：少样本模型无关元学习与自编码器集成
abstract_cn: 勒索软件已成为主要网络安全威胁，其在关键行业的频率与影响持续上升。这些攻击通常经钓鱼邮件、恶意下载或利用软件漏洞获取系统访问。入侵后，恶意软件加密文件并常以加密货币索要赎金换取解密密钥。传统检测方法在新样本或稀缺样本上常显乏力，使系统易受攻击。为应对这些挑战，本文提出一个混合深度学习框架，把自编码器特征提取器（AFE）与模型无关元学习（MAML）分类器结合用于少样本恶意软件检测。AFE 生成紧凑潜在特征以降噪降维，MAML 分类器用有限标注数据快速适应新威胁。在 Ransomware Dataset 2024 上的实验证明了该框架在二分类任务上的有效性：从 1 到 50 shot 设置中，所提模型持续取得高准确率、F1 与马修斯相关系数（MCC），在极端稀缺下仍保持可靠分类。结果凸显该模型在少样本场景中的鲁棒性与有效性，展示结合特征提取与元学习以增强恶意软件抵抗力的潜力，尤其适用于可能遭受重大运营与财务干扰的医疗、制造与公共基础设施等行业。（CARS 接收）
summary_cn: 提出自编码器特征提取+MAML 元学习的少样本勒索软件检测：Ransomware Dataset 2024 上 1–50 shot 各设置保持高准确率/F1/MCC，面向样本稀缺场景（CARS 接收）。
objective_summary: 构建 AFE+MAML 的少样本恶意软件二分类框架，在 Ransomware Dataset 2024 上跨 1–50 shot 设置评估准确率、F1 与 MCC。
evidence_note: 单一数据集（Ransomware Dataset 2024）、二分类设置；摘要未列基线对比细节与统计检验；行业会议（CARS）论文。
novelty_note: 自编码器与 MAML 均为成熟组件，组合用于恶意软件少样本检测属增量应用。
scope: 结论限于该勒索软件数据集的二分类任务与 1–50 shot 范围；对多类家族、加壳变形与概念漂移未验证。
limitations: 未与已发表的少样本恶意软件检测基线直接对比；数据集时效与真实流量代表性未知；元学习训练成本未报告。

title: Supersingularity and Superspeciality Verification of Abelian Surfaces
abstract: Supersingular abelian surfaces are essential in isogeny-based cryptography. Despite this, we have no efficient algorithm to verify if a given abelian surface is supersingular. In this work, we initiate this research topic by giving an efficient Monte Carlo algorithm to verify if an abelian surface over $\mathbb{F}_p$ is supersingular in $O(\log p)$ with negligible failure probability, and an efficient conclusive algorithm if the order is smooth. We derive this algorithm by a careful analysis on the structure of supersingular Jacobians over $\mathbb{F}_p$. Furthermore, we derive efficient algorithms to verify if an abelian variety of any dimension is minimal or maximal, and to verify if a Jacobian of any dimension is superspecial.
title_cn: 阿贝尔曲面的超奇异与超特殊验证
abstract_cn: 超奇异阿贝尔曲面在同源密码中至关重要。尽管如此，我们尚无高效算法验证给定阿贝尔曲面是否超奇异。本工作发起该研究课题：给出一个高效蒙特卡洛算法，以 O(log p) 时间、可忽略失败概率验证 F_p 上的阿贝尔曲面是否超奇异；并在阶光滑时给出结论性算法。我们通过仔细分析 F_p 上超奇异雅可比簇的结构导出该算法。此外，我们导出高效算法验证任意维数的阿贝尔簇是否极小或极大，以及验证任意维数的雅可比簇是否超特殊。
summary_cn: 给出验证 F_p 上阿贝尔曲面超奇异性的 O(log p) 蒙特卡洛算法（可忽略失败概率）与阶光滑时的结论性算法，并推广到任意维数的极小/极大/超特殊验证。
objective_summary: 基于超奇异雅可比簇结构分析，构造超奇异性验证的蒙特卡洛与结论性算法，并推广到极小性、极大性与超特殊性验证。
evidence_note: 算法复杂度与失败概率有证明，但摘要未含实现基准或与既有方法的实测对比；为新课题的首批结果。
novelty_note: 填补「超奇异性验证无高效算法」的空白并发起研究方向；O(log p) 的效率对同源密码参数验证有直接意义。
scope: 结论限于 F_p 上的阿贝尔曲面与雅可比簇的代数验证；蒙特卡洛算法有可忽略失败概率；光滑阶假设仅用于结论性变体。
limitations: 无实现与实验计时数据；结论性算法依赖阶光滑这一额外条件；对密码实践中具体曲线族的适用步骤未演示。

title: Detection and Resolution of Periodic Artifacts in OpenDP's Discrete Laplace Sampler
abstract: Differential privacy implementations rely on precise sampling from noise distributions to provide formal privacy guarantees. We report the discovery of systematic artifacts in OpenDP's discrete Laplace sampler that manifest as periodic distortions in the output distribution. Through systematic testing, we trace these artifacts to a faulty implementation in the rational arithmetic library used by the bernoulli_exp1 function, a low-level primitive that implements sampling from Bernoulli(e^(-x)) distributions. We present a diagnostic methodology that isolates the faulty component in the nested sampling hierarchy and propose an alternative implementation based on exact rational arithmetic that eliminates the artifacts. Statistical validation with 10^6 samples confirms that the corrected sampler produces outputs indistinguishable from the theoretical distribution at the tested precision level.
title_cn: OpenDP 离散拉普拉斯采样器周期性伪影的检测与修复
abstract_cn: 差分隐私的实现依赖从噪声分布的精确采样以提供形式隐私保证。我们报告在 OpenDP 的离散拉普拉斯采样器中发现的系统性伪影：表现为输出分布的周期性畸变。通过系统测试，我们把伪影追溯到 bernoulli_exp1 函数所用有理算术库中的一个错误实现——该低层原语实现 Bernoulli(e^(−x)) 分布的采样。我们提出一种在嵌套采样层级中隔离故障组件的诊断方法，并提出基于精确有理算术的替代实现以消除伪影。10⁶ 样本的统计验证确认：修正后的采样器在所测精度水平上产出与理论分布不可区分的输出。
summary_cn: 发现 OpenDP 离散拉普拉斯采样器的周期性输出畸变，追溯到 bernoulli_exp1 底层有理算术实现的缺陷；给出精确有理算术替代实现，10⁶ 样本验证与理论分布不可区分。
objective_summary: 诊断并定位 OpenDP 离散拉普拉斯采样器的周期性伪影根源，提出精确有理算术的修复实现并以统计验证确认。
evidence_note: 系统测试定位根因 + 10⁶ 样本统计验证的完整证据链；受影响精度水平的范围评估未在摘要量化。
novelty_note: 对广泛使用的 DP 库采样器的实现缺陷做有诊断价值的发现与修复，直接关系隐私保证的可靠性。
scope: 结论适用于 OpenDP 该版本的离散拉普拉斯采样路径；修复在所测精度水平验证；对依赖同一有理算术库的其他原语未系统排查。
limitations: 仅覆盖一个采样器与一个根因；伪影对下游 ε 保证的定量影响未推导；上游库采纳与回归测试状态未知。

title: A Structured State Space Sequence Model for Multi-Class Classification of Malware
abstract: By 2030, Internet of Things (IoT) devices are projected to reach 40 billion, with fast-paced technological advancements in fields such as industry, healthcare, agriculture, automobiles, and building/home automation systems. This expansion has created a large attack surface for cybercrime, as the majority of these devices open the door for cybercriminals to exploit vulnerabilities, as they lack adequate built-in security. Cybercriminals launch malware attacks to compromise systems or steal sensitive data, and once a system is compromised, a ransom is typically demanded for its release. Current cybersecurity measures in place are being outpaced by the rapid growth of the IoT, which is accompanied by a subsequent growth in malware variants being created per day. Recognizing this pitfall, this research examines and proposes a novel approach to malware detection and classification to safeguard devices from further attacks and make IoT systems more robust and secure. The framework proposed utilizes a Structured State Space Sequence (S4) model, which discretizes sequences of malware samples in a sequence and captures long-range dependencies, essentially identifying the "cause" and "effect" hidden within malware execution flow. This study presents two novel contributions: the first empirical application of the S4 model for malware analysis, and a comprehensive comparison of its performance against other deep learning architectures, laying the stepping stone for future research in this new paradigm.
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE World AI IoT Congress (AIIoT). This is the author's accepted manuscript
title_cn: 面向恶意软件多类分类的结构化状态空间序列模型
abstract_cn: 到 2030 年，物联网（IoT）设备预计达 400 亿台，伴随工业、医疗、农业、汽车与楼宇自动化等领域的快速技术进步。这种扩张为网络犯罪创造了巨大攻击面——多数设备缺乏内建安全，为网络罪犯开门。网络罪犯发动恶意软件攻击以入侵系统或窃取敏感数据，系统一旦被入侵通常被索要赎金以换取解密。现有网络安全措施正被 IoT 的快速增长甩开——伴随每日新增恶意软件变体的增长。认识到这一困境，本研究考察并提出一种恶意软件检测与分类的新方法，以保护设备免受进一步攻击、增强 IoT 系统鲁棒性。所提框架利用结构化状态空间序列（S4）模型——把恶意软件样本序列离散化并捕捉长程依赖，本质上是识别恶意软件执行流中隐藏的「因」与「果」。本研究给出两个新贡献：S4 模型在恶意软件分析中的首次实证应用，以及其与其他深度学习架构的全面比较，为这一新范式的后续研究奠定基石。（AIIoT 2026 接收）
summary_cn: 首次把结构化状态空间序列（S4）模型应用于恶意软件多类分类，并与其他深度学习架构全面比较，利用其长程依赖建模刻画执行流的因果关系（AIIoT 2026）。
objective_summary: 将 S4 序列模型引入恶意软件分类并与既有深度架构对比性能，验证其对执行流长程依赖的建模效果。
evidence_note: 单一研究的架构对比，数据集规模与基线细节摘要未列明；行业会议（AIIoT 2026）论文；无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把已有 S4 架构搬到恶意软件分类的首次应用；无新机制，价值在架构迁移的实证记录。
scope: 结论适用于样本可序列化的恶意软件分类任务；S4 的长序列优势依赖样本表示方式；对打包/加壳与对抗样本鲁棒性未测。
limitations: 未报告推理开销与部署可行性；与 Transformer/CNN 等基线的对比设置摘要不详；IoT 背景叙述与实验配置的关联未明确。

title: From Network Intrusion Detection to Blockchain-Backed Endpoint Detection and Response: Mapping the Landscape of Decentralized Detection-and-Response Architectures
abstract: While the literature on blockchain-assisted intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS) for Internet of Things (IoT) and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks is mature, existing systematic reviews suffer from two critical limitations: they overlook the structural shift toward modern Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Extended Detection and Response (XDR) architectures, and they conflate blockchain's distinct functional roles into a single monolithic category. This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) addresses these gaps by proposing a three-axis taxonomy that classifies proposals by detection-system class (NIDS, HIDS, EDR/XDR), blockchain functional role, and response-automation maturity. Synthesizing research published in high-impact venues between 2019 and 2026, we provide a rigorous gap analysis exposing why a genuine per-endpoint blockchain-anchored response loop remains nearly nonexistent due to latency, deployment, and community mismatches. Furthermore, we evaluate structural, cross-cutting challenges persisting across the literature, including consensus latency on constrained devices, post-quantum cryptographic vulnerability, smart-contract attack surfaces, and the adversarial vulnerability of evolving LLM-based detection engines. Finally, we outline a comprehensive research agenda centered on hybrid on-chain/off-chain orchestration to bridge the gap between decentralized trust and rapid response automation.
title_cn: 从网络入侵检测到区块链支撑的端点检测与响应：去中心化检测-响应架构版图
abstract_cn: 关于区块链辅助入侵检测与防御系统（IDS/IPS）在物联网（IoT）与工业物联网（IIoT）网络的文献已成熟，但现有系统综述有两个关键局限：忽视向现代端点检测与响应（EDR）及扩展检测与响应（XDR）架构的结构性转变，并把区块链的不同功能角色混为一类。本知识系统化（SoK）以三轴分类法弥补这些缺口：按检测系统类别（NIDS、HIDS、EDR/XDR）、区块链功能角色与响应自动化成熟度分类已有提案。综合 2019 至 2026 年高影响力期刊研究，我们给出严格的缺口分析，揭示为何真正的端点级区块链锚定响应环因延迟、部署与社区错配而几乎不存在。我们进一步评估文献中持续存在的结构性横向挑战，包括受限设备上的共识延迟、后量子密码脆弱性、智能合约攻击面与演化中基于 LLM 检测引擎的对抗脆弱性。最后我们概述以混合链上/链下编排为中心的研究议程，弥合去中心化信任与快速响应自动化之间的鸿沟。
summary_cn: SoK：以三轴分类法（检测系统类别×区块链角色×响应自动化成熟度）梳理 2019–2026 年区块链辅助 IDS/EDR 研究，指出端点级区块链响应环几乎不存在及其延迟/部署/社区根因，并给出混合链上/链下议程。
objective_summary: 系统化区块链辅助入侵检测与响应文献，构建三轴分类法并分析 EDR/XDR 转向下的缺口与横向挑战。
evidence_note: 系统性文献综合（2019–2026 高影响力期刊），无新实验；缺口分析依赖其分类口径。
novelty_note: 相对既有综述的增量在于纳入 EDR/XDR 类别与拆分区块链角色；主题与结论多为领域共识的重新组织。
scope: 覆盖 IoT/IIoT 场景的区块链-检测系统交叉文献；结论受检索口径（高影响力期刊）限制；对非区块链的 EDR 体系仅作对照。
limitations: 三轴分类对混合角色系统的归属存在边界模糊；「几乎不存在」的判断难以完全穷证；研究议程未排出优先级与可行性评估。

title: Walking the Embedding Space: Datastore Extraction from Multimodal RAG
abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has emerged as a reliable and cost-effective technique of grounding the generative capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into relevant, up-to-date, external knowledge. Despite presenting several benefits, such as reducing hallucinatory behavior, they also introduce new attack surfaces, including leakage of private information and vulnerabilities against data extraction attacks. In this paper, we introduce $\immrag$, an adaptive and automatic data extraction attack procedure operating in a black box setting against \emph{image-returning} MRAG, a configuration in which the retrieved visual artifact is itself the response. Each query blends an attacker-held shadow image with an image already recovered from the system, and relevance-weighted resampling steers subsequent queries towards regions of the embedding space that still yield novel retrievals. Unlike current extraction attacks that aim to persuade the model towards data leakage by placing a malicious query as a textual prompt, $\immrag$ embeds the malicious instructions inside a user-given input image. We evaluate $\immrag$ on three plausible and distinct real-world scenarios: medical assistant, document-focused helper and general purpose tool. The experiments involve the study of the effectiveness of the attack on multiple CLIP-family retrievers, as well as the impact of various generators. A single 2500-query run reconstructs up to 611 distinct radiology images, 566 document scans and 416 general-purpose images under local-feature correspondence, and reaches up to $5.6\times$ as many distinct datastore items as a non-adaptive baseline. Our results show the urgent need for safeguards specifically designed for multimodal data.
title_cn: 行走嵌入空间：从多模态 RAG 提取数据存储
abstract_cn: 多模态检索增强生成（MRAG）已成为把多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的生成能力锚定到相关、最新的外部知识的可靠且经济的技术。尽管有减少幻觉等优点，它也引入新的攻击面，包括隐私信息泄露与对数据提取攻击的脆弱性。本文提出 immrag，一种在黑盒设定下对抗「返回图像」型 MRAG——检索到的视觉工件本身就是响应的配置——的自适应、自动化数据提取攻击程序。每个查询把攻击者持有的影子图像与已从系统恢复的图像混合，相关性加权的重采样引导后续查询走向嵌入空间中仍能产生新检索的区域。与当前通过在文本提示中放置恶意查询来说服模型泄露的提取攻击不同，immrag 把恶意指令嵌入用户给定的输入图像内。我们在三个合理且互异的真实场景上评估：医疗助手、文档聚焦助手与通用工具。实验研究攻击对多个 CLIP 族检索器的有效性以及不同生成器的影响。单次 2,500 查询运行在局部特征对应下重建多达 611 张不同放射影像、566 份文档扫描与 416 张通用图像，并达到非自适应基线 5.6 倍的不同数据存储条目数。结果表明迫切需要专门为多模态数据设计的防护措施。
summary_cn: 提出针对图像返回型 MRAG 的黑盒提取攻击 immrag：影子图像+已恢复图像混合查询、相关性加权重采样，恶意指令藏于输入图像；2,500 查询单轮最多重建 611 张放射影像，达非自适应基线 5.6 倍。
objective_summary: 设计对图像返回型 MRAG 的自适应数据存储提取攻击（图像内嵌指令+嵌入空间重采样），在医疗/文档/通用三场景、多检索器与生成器上量化重建量。
evidence_note: 三场景×多检索器×多生成器的系统实验、与非自适应基线的倍数对比；无统计检验，重建的语义等价性评估口径未详。
novelty_note: 开辟「图像返回型 MRAG 数据存储提取」这一新攻击配置，把指令从文本提示移入输入图像；对该模态组合属首个系统攻击。
scope: 结论适用于以 CLIP 族检索器返回图像的 MRAG 部署；攻击假设可无限查询并观测返回图像；对有速率限制或返回降质图像的部署效果未知。
limitations: 评估限于 CLIP 族检索器与白盒可观测返回；提取量与数据存储规模及去重策略强相关；未提出或测试针对性防御。

title: Trapdoored Clifford Operators and Applications
abstract: Random Clifford operators have numerous applications in quantum computing, including randomized benchmarking, classical shadows, and quantum authentication. However, sampling and implementing uniformly random $n$-qubit Clifford incur near-quadratic complexity due to the size of Clifford group. We introduce a cryptographic way to overcome these barriers: trapdoored Clifford operator distributions whose samples are computationally indistinguishable from uniformly random Cliffords, yet implementing them can be much faster given the trapdoor. We construct a distribution of trapdoored Clifford operators whose elements can be sampled and implemented in near-linear time under a variant of the learning parity with noise assumption. Our constructions allow fast tableau action on Pauli labels for classical simulation, and also can be optimized to admit polylogarithmic-depth implementation. Along the way, we construct trapdoored matrices over finite fields that support efficient multiplication by both a matrix and its inverse, resolving an open question left by Vaikuntanathan and Zamir [SODA'26]. We use these constructions to obtain faster protocols based on random Cliffords. We also explore their applications to the worst-case to average-case reductions for matrix and Clifford problems including the iterated matrix multiplication and Clifford circuit synthesis. In particular, we show the hardness of batching Clifford circuits: synthesizing circuits that apply the same Clifford to multiple registers is at least as hard as worst-case matrix multiplication, even when synthesis succeeds on a small constant fraction of random Cliffords. This extends to approximate implementations by general quantum circuits.
title_cn: 陷门 Clifford 算子及其应用
abstract_cn: 随机 Clifford 算子在量子计算中有众多应用，包括随机化基准测试、经典阴影与量子认证。但采样并实现均匀随机的 n 比特 Clifford 因 Clifford 群规模而具有近二次复杂度。我们引入一种密码学方式克服这些障碍：陷门 Clifford 算子分布——其样本与均匀随机 Clifford 计算不可区分，但持有陷门时实现可快得多。我们在学习奇偶性与噪声（LPN）假设的一个变体下构造了一个陷门 Clifford 算子分布，其元素可以近线性时间采样与实现。我们的构造支持对 Pauli 标签的快速 tableau 作用以用于经典模拟，并可优化为多对数深度实现。过程中我们构造了有限域上支持矩阵与其逆都高效乘法的陷门矩阵，解决了 Vaikuntanathan 与 Zamir[SODA'26] 留下的公开问题。我们用这些构造获得基于随机 Clifford 的更快协议，并探索其在矩阵与 Clifford 问题（含迭代矩阵乘法与 Clifford 电路合成）的最坏情况到平均情况归约中的应用。特别地，我们证明批处理 Clifford 电路的困难性：合成把同一 Clifford 应用到多个寄存器的电路，至少与最坏情况矩阵乘法一样难——即使合成只需在小常数比例的随机 Clifford 上成功。该结果可推广到一般量子电路的近似实现。
summary_cn: 在 LPN 变体假设下构造陷门 Clifford 分布：采样与实现近线性（可优化到多对数深度）且与均匀随机计算不可区分；顺带解决 SODA'26 陷门矩阵公开问题，并证明 Clifford 批处理合成的最坏情况困难性。
objective_summary: 构造计算不可区分于均匀 Clifford 的陷门分布与配套陷门矩阵，给出快速 tableau 作用与多对数深度实现，并应用于随机化协议加速与最坏情况归约。
evidence_note: 在标准 LPN 变体下的完整构造与归约证明，解决公开问题并给出新的困难性结果；纯理论，以定理为据。
novelty_note: 把陷门思想引入 Clifford 采样这一非传统密码对象，开辟密码学与量子基准测试/认证的交叉路线；附带解决已知公开问题。
scope: 结论在 LPN 变体假设的经典敌手模型内成立；应用限于以随机 Clifford 为组件的协议（基准测试、阴影、认证）；不涉及物理噪声设备。
limitations: 近似实现的结果依赖小常数成功率参数；陷门管理的实际协议集成未给出；量子对手模型未单独处理。

title: A Safe Prototype Is Not a Safety Direction: Reference Dependence and Prompt Confounds in Response-Safety Embeddings
abstract: Can response safety be scored by cosine similarity to the mean embedding of known-safe responses? A recent sleeper-agent detector proposes exactly this score, yet the raw positive-centroid rule is not identified: positive observations locate the safe class relative to an encoder origin, but do not determine which direction separates safe from unsafe responses. We audit the rule on two prompt-controlled, human-labeled corpora and one auxiliary jury-labeled source control, using four frozen encoders and prompt-grouped splits. On the human-labeled corpora the safe prototype reaches ROC-AUC 0.457-0.545, with two cells significantly below chance and one above, while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference reaches 0.588-0.738 on the same embeddings; on the jury control the prototype is inverted (0.358-0.405) and the reference reaches 0.754-0.793. At validation-calibrated 5% false-safe thresholds, the reference accepts more safe responses on PKU-SafeRLHF (0.153-0.263 versus 0.039-0.061 across encoders) and Aegis (0.189-0.291 versus 0.004-0.045), but not reliably on BeaverTails. A fully unlabeled held-out reference recovers part to most of the referenced ranking, much less when only 5% of the pool is unsafe, whereas 80-634 labeled unsafe responses recover most of it. Prompt-only ablations show that prompt-label composition can inflate uncontrolled evaluations. This is a bounded result about a raw positive centroid, not all one-class methods or safety-specialized guards. A class mean is a location, not necessarily a safety direction; a declared reference with enough unsafe mass identifies orientation.
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec). 15 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code, results, and a verifier are in the ancillary files
title_cn: 安全原型不是安全方向：响应安全嵌入中的参考依赖与提示混淆
abstract_cn: 响应安全能否通过与「已知安全响应均值嵌入」的余弦相似度打分？一个近期的睡眠智能体检测器正是提出该分数。但原始正质心规则不可识别：正样本只相对编码器原点定位安全类，并不决定分离安全与不安全响应的方向。我们在两个提示受控、人工标注的语料与一个辅助评审标注的源对照上审计该规则，使用四个冻结编码器与按提示分组的分割。在人工标注语料上，安全原型 ROC-AUC 为 0.457–0.545（两格显著低于随机、一格高于随机），而显式的安全减不安全参考在同一嵌入上达 0.588–0.738；在评审对照上原型被反转（0.358–0.405），参考达 0.754–0.793。在校准到 5% 误安全阈下，参考在 PKU-SafeRLHF（0.153–0.263 对 0.039–0.061）与 Aegis（0.189–0.291 对 0.004–0.045）上接受更多安全响应，但在 BeaverTails 上不稳定。完全无标签的留出参考恢复部分到大部分的参考排序，而当池中仅 5% 不安全时恢复少得多，而 80–634 个标注不安全响应即可恢复大部分。仅提示消融显示提示-标签构成可膨胀未受控评估。这是关于原始正质心的有界结论，不针对所有单类方法或安全专用守卫。类均值是一个位置，不必然是安全方向；声明式参考加上足够的不安全质量才能确定朝向。（NeurIPS 2026 FLMSec workshop）
summary_cn: 审计「安全响应均值余弦」检测规则：人工语料上 ROC-AUC 仅 0.457–0.545（评审对照上反转），显式安全-不安全参考达 0.588–0.793；80–634 条标注不安全样本即可恢复大部分排序——类均值是位置不是方向。
objective_summary: 在提示受控语料上系统审计正质心安全评分的识别性，与显式参考方向、无标签参考及标注预算消融比较 ROC-AUC 与校准误安全率。
evidence_note: 两人工语料+一评审对照、四编码器、按提示分组分割与校准阈值；结论明确有界（仅针对原始正质心），工件随论文附于 ancillary files。
novelty_note: 对已发表检测器规则给出带替代方案的实证修正（质心≠方向），并量化标注预算需求；对部署与后续研究有直接校正价值。
scope: 结论只针对「原始正质心」这一具体规则，不外推到所有单类方法或安全守卫；评估限于所测英文安全语料与冻结编码器。
limitations: 语料规模与标注口径限制外推；替代参考的构建本身需不安全样本；对原始系统的完整复现范围有限。

title: Learnt Attacks on Quantum Key Distribution under Channel Noise and Device Drift
abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) links are provisioned from security analyses of stationary channels, whereas the devices that determine the channel drift between recalibrations. Whether an eavesdropper who cannot alter the channel's own noise gains by following that drift has not been quantified. Adaptive eavesdropping is posed here as a constrained Markov decision process in which the attacker selects one circuit per round while the noise level follows an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process and the abort condition is a budget over each block of rounds. The value of adaptation is bounded by the best fixed circuit and a dynamic-programming upper bound. The actions are learnt attacks. Whereas Decker et al. trained a parametrised circuit on a fixed gate template against a fixed channel, here the gate structure and rotation angles are searched jointly. This yields circuits compact enough to form a discrete action set, extending the construction to noise models lacking a known template, including the amplitude damping channel. On device-independent E91 under bilateral depolarising noise, a reinforcement-learning attacker raises her Holevo information from $0.135$ for the best fixed circuit to $0.348$ at zero detection, $98\%$ of the upper bound. On BB84 under a drifting bit-flip channel, she exceeds a conservative noise-indexed rule by $0.024$ in fidelity, reaching $99\%$ of the upper bound. Under stationary noise, the attacker's gain from basis asymmetry changes sign between an averaged and a per-basis error-rate constraint. The search, started from random gate sequences, recovers the analytical cloners and the collective-attack key rate, and meets the lower bound of the Winick--L\"utkenhaus--Coles objective from above.
comment: Presented as submission 202 at QCrypt 2026 this http URL. A parallel work exploring the machine-learning aspects of this approach, titled "Sparsity for Free: A Budget-Induced Equilibrium in Joint Topology-Parameter Search'', has been accepted for NeurIPS 2026
title_cn: 信道噪声与设备漂移下量子密钥分发的学习型攻击
abstract_cn: 量子密钥分发（QKD）链路按平稳信道的安全分析供应，而决定信道在重校准间漂移的正是设备。无法改变信道自身噪声的窃听者若跟随该漂移能获益多少，此前未被量化。本文把自适应窃听表述为一个受约束马尔可夫决策过程：攻击者每轮选择一个电路，噪声水平遵循 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 过程，中止条件为每块轮数上的预算。自适应的价值被最佳固定电路与动态规划上界所界定。其动作是学习型攻击：Decker 等人在固定门模板上针对固定信道训练参数化电路，而本文联合搜索门结构与旋转角度，得到紧凑到可构成离散动作集的电路，并把构造扩展到缺乏已知模板的噪声模型，包括振幅阻尼信道。在双边退极化噪声下的设备无关 E91 上，强化学习攻击者把其 Holevo 信息从最佳固定电路的 0.135 提高到零检测处的 0.348——上界的 98%；在漂移比特翻转信道下的 BB84 上，她以保真度超出保守的按噪声索引规则 0.024，达上界的 99%。平稳噪声下，攻击者从基不对称获得的收益在平均与逐基错误率约束之间变号。从随机门序列出发的搜索恢复了分析式克隆器与集体攻击密钥率，并从上方达到 Winick–Lütkenhaus–Coles 目标的下界。（QCrypt 2026 提交 202）
summary_cn: 把 QKD 自适应窃听建模为受限 MDP 并联合搜索门结构+角度的学习型攻击：E91 上 Holevo 信息 0.135→0.348（上界 98%）、BB84 漂移信道达上界 99%，并恢复分析式克隆器与集体攻击密钥率。
objective_summary: 构建跟随信道漂移的学习型 QKD 窃听（受限 MDP+联合门结构/角度搜索），在 E91/BB84 噪声模型上量化相对最佳固定电路的增益并对照动态规划上界。
evidence_note: 与上界的系统性对照（98%/99%）及对解析结果的恢复验证；仿真信道模型，无真实 QKD 硬件实验；QCrypt 提交流程部分保证质量。
novelty_note: 把「漂移自适应窃听」形式化并量化此前未测的增益；联合搜索扩展克隆器构造到无模板噪声模型，属既有学习攻击方向的实质推进。
scope: 结论适用于所测噪声模型（退极化、振幅阻尼、漂移比特翻转）与 E91/BB84 协议；安全影响以 Holevo 信息/保真度代理；真实设备缺陷合并建模未含。
limitations: 攻击评估在仿真信道上，真实链路校准漂移更复杂；MDP 预算与中止条件为简化设定；对测量设备无关协议未测。

title: SAGE: Similarity-Based Cleaning of Poisoned Training Data from Verified Examples
abstract: As machine learning increasingly relies on public, untrusted data sources, data poisoning attacks, which inject malicious examples into training data to induce misclassification of a chosen target, pose a growing threat. Existing defenses either assume zero ground-truth information about which examples are poisoned, or they assume access to a large set of examples verified to be clean. Satisfying the latter assumption incurs significant cost since reliable verification can be very resource- or labor-intensive. This cost is particularly high for clean-label attacks, where poisoned examples are visually indistinguishable from clean data. Since requiring a large set of verified examples is impractical, we propose relying on a small set of verified examples including both clean and poisoned ones, i.e., each example verified either to be clean or poisoned through inspection by a forensic expert. The challenge is then to detect poisons based on a set of verified examples that is so small that most classification models would overfit. To address this challenge, we propose Similarity-based Approach for Ground-truth-driven Exclusion (SAGE), which trains a generic feature extractor on a separate dataset and then flags poisoned training examples using a non-parametric, similarity-weighted prediction based on the verified set. On standard benchmarks against seven clean-label attack methods, we demonstrate that having access to even a handful of verified poisoned examples provides a substantial advantage. We also find that the distribution of verified clean examples across classes matters more than the number of verified examples.
title_cn: SAGE：基于已验证样本相似性清洗被投毒训练数据
abstract_cn: 随着机器学习日益依赖公开、不可信的数据源，把恶意样本注入训练数据以诱导对选定目标误分类的数据投毒攻击构成日益增长的威胁。现有防御要么假设对哪些样本被投毒完全没有真值信息，要么假设可以访问大量经验证干净的样本。满足后一假设成本高昂，因为可靠验证非常耗资源或人力——对干净标签攻击尤甚：投毒样本在视觉上与干净数据无法区分。既然要求大量已验证样本不切实际，我们提出依赖一小组已验证样本（同时包含干净与投毒样本，即每个样本由取证专家核实为干净或投毒）。挑战在于基于小组验证样本检测投毒——小组之小足以让多数分类模型过拟合。为此我们提出 SAGE（Similarity-based Approach for Ground-truth-driven Exclusion）：在单独数据集上训练通用特征提取器，然后基于验证集做非参数、相似度加权的预测来标记投毒训练样本。在针对七种干净标签攻击方法的标准基准上，我们证明哪怕只访问少量已验证投毒样本也能带来实质优势。我们还发现：已验证干净样本跨类别的分布比已验证样本的数量更重要。
summary_cn: 提出 SAGE：仅需少量经专家验证的干净+投毒样本，用预训练特征+非参数相似度加权预测标记投毒数据；七种干净标签攻击上少量验证样本即带来实质优势，且干净样本的跨类分布比数量更关键。
objective_summary: 构建以小规模专家验证集为监督、相似度加权非参数检测的投毒清洗方法 SAGE，并在七种干净标签攻击上量化验证集规模与分布的影响。
evidence_note: 七种干净标签攻击的标准基准对比与验证集消融；自建评估协议、无统计检验，取证验证成本未量化。
novelty_note: 把防御假设从「大量验证样本/零真值」放松到「少量混合验证样本」，并给出分布比数量更重要的实证发现；组件为已有技术的新配置。
scope: 结论适用于图像分类与干净标签投毒场景；依赖通用特征提取器与目标数据的相似性；对触发式后门（非干净标签）与文本模态未测。
limitations: 专家验证的少量投毒样本在现实中不易获得；特征提取器域差可能削弱相似性信号；跨类分布依赖需要按类分配验证预算的先验知识。

title: QUFIG: GNN-Based Prediction of Quantum Fault Injection Vulnerabilities with Gate-Level Precision
abstract: The growing scale and accessibility of quantum hardware exposed new reliability and security challenges in the quantum computing workflow, such as the run-time fault injection attacks in cloud-based quantum computing platforms. However, existing works fail to identify vulnerabilities with gate-level precision or adapt to run-time environments. In this work, we formulate gate-level fault analysis as a learning-guided prioritization problem under restricted fidelity budgets. The framework uses a circuit-DAG-based GNN backbone to predict the vulnerability score of each gate to each type of injected fault, defined as the impact of the gate-fault pair on circuit fidelity. The gate-fault pairs are then ranked by their vulnerability score. Experiments on QASMbench and HamLib MaxCut show that QUFIG recovers high-impact vulnerable gate-fault pairs with fewer inspections than random and depth-based heuristics. Our results show that QUFIG can reduce the number of gates requiring inspection by 2.9--19.8% while maintaining effective fault identification, allowing quantum circuit designers to identify vulnerabilities and apply targeted defenses more efficiently.
comment: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Computer Design (ICCD) 2026
title_cn: QUFIG：具备门级精度的量子故障注入漏洞 GNN 预测
abstract_cn: 量子硬件的规模与可及性增长暴露了量子计算工作流中新的可靠性与安全挑战，例如云量子计算平台上的运行时故障注入攻击。但现有工作无法以门级精度识别漏洞或适应运行时环境。本工作把门级故障分析形式化为保真度预算受限下的学习引导优先级排序问题。框架使用基于电路 DAG 的 GNN 骨干，预测每个门对每种注入故障类型的漏洞分数——定义为门-故障对对电路保真度的影响——然后按漏洞分数排序门-故障对。在 QASMbench 与 HamLib MaxCut 上的实验表明，QUFIG 以少于随机与深度启发式的检查恢复高影响的易受攻击门-故障对。结果显示 QUFIG 能把需要检查的门数减少 2.9–19.8% 同时保持有效故障识别，让量子电路设计者更高效地识别漏洞并施加针对性防御。（ICCD 2026 接收）
summary_cn: 提出电路 DAG-GNN 的门级故障注入漏洞预测 QUFIG：按门-故障对保真度影响排序，QASMbench/HamLib 上较随机与深度启发式减少 2.9–19.8% 的需检门数（ICCD 2026）。
objective_summary: 把门级故障分析形式化为学习引导排序问题，构建电路 DAG GNN 预测门-故障对漏洞分数，并在两个基准上与启发式比较检查预算。
evidence_note: 两个基准上与随机/深度启发式的预算对比，ICCD 2026 接收；漏洞分数依赖保真度仿真定义，无真实云平台攻击实验。
novelty_note: 把 GNN 引入门级故障注入优先级排序并给出保真度预算下的具体节省；组件（GNN、电路 DAG）成熟，问题设定有一定新意。
scope: 结论适用于可仿真的量子电路与所测故障类型；对真实云平台的运行时攻击面与噪声设备未验证；分数定义依赖保真度代理的准确性。
limitations: 节省幅度（≤19.8%）温和；GNN 训练依赖仿真标签的分布；对自适应攻击者选择注入位置的鲁棒性未评估。

title: The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching
abstract: With the increasing capabilities of Large-Language-Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents, users are increasingly using them to solve everyday problems, such as answering e-mails or providing programming support. Existing work has extensively investigated security and privacy risks, such as prompt injections and the disclosure of sensitive data to chatbot providers. While various solutions were developed to address these risks, including input structuring to prevent prompt injections or deploying local LLMs to avoid sharing confidential data with chatbot operators, LLMs also pose the risk of leaking confidential data to third parties. In this paper, we demonstrate with LLMLeak a novel attack vector where malicious software that runs locally but cannot communicate directly with the internet abuses LLMs to establish a covert channel. While inputs that instruct the LLM to send data directly via generated code are easy to detect and network libraries are typically restricted, LLMLeak relies only on the LLM's tool to fetch websites for further information. A malicious software component on the client side embeds a secret into a URL. It presents the referenced website as providing information required for a benign task, such as migrating a software library. When the LLM accesses the URL, the attacker receives the encoded secret through an attacker-controlled DNS or web server. We perform an extensive evaluation on eleven open-parameter models, observe an attack success rate of 79.7%, and also conduct a case study on real-world chatbots, demonstrating the relevance of LLMLeak.
title_cn: 无辜信使：经由合法 LLM 网页抓取的隐蔽外泄
abstract_cn: 随着大语言模型（LLM）与基于 LLM 的智能体能力增强，用户日益用它们解决日常问题，如回答邮件或提供编程支持。现有工作已广泛研究安全与隐私风险，如提示注入与向聊天机器人提供商泄露敏感数据。尽管已有多种方案应对这些风险——包括防止提示注入的输入结构化、或部署本地 LLM 以避免与聊天机器人运营方共享机密数据——LLM 还存在向第三方泄露机密数据的风险。本文用 LLMLeak 展示一种新型攻击向量：在本地运行、却无法直接联网的恶意软件滥用 LLM 建立隐蔽信道。指示 LLM 通过生成代码直接发送数据的输入容易被检测，且网络库通常受限；LLMLeak 仅依赖 LLM 抓取网站以获取进一步信息的工具。客户端的恶意软件组件把秘密嵌入 URL，并把所引网站呈现为完成良性任务（如迁移软件库）所需的信息来源。当 LLM 访问该 URL 时，攻击者经其控制的 DNS 或 Web 服务器接收编码后的秘密。我们在十一个开放参数模型上做了广泛评估，观测到 79.7% 的攻击成功率，并对真实聊天机器人做了案例研究，显示 LLMLeak 的现实相关性。
summary_cn: 提出 LLMLeak 隐蔽信道：无法联网的本地恶意软件把秘密嵌入 URL，诱使 LLM 用其抓取工具访问从而经攻击者 DNS/服务器外泄；11 个开放参数模型上成功率 79.7%，真实聊天机器人案例验证可行性。
objective_summary: 设计并评估把 LLM 合法网页抓取工具变成外泄信道的攻击 LLMLeak，测量开放参数模型上的成功率并做真实服务案例研究。
evidence_note: 11 个模型的成功率量化与真实聊天机器人案例研究；无统计检验，越狱可靠性随模型对齐更新可能漂移。
novelty_note: 把「URL 即外泄信道」与 LLM 合法抓取工具组合，攻击面（无法联网的恶意软件也能外泄）有新意；URL 编码外泄与工具滥用组件各有前身。
scope: 结论适用于具有网页抓取工具且提示可诱导 URL 构造的 LLM 部署；依赖模型服从生成含密 URL；对已限制抓取或强制白名单的环境不适用。
limitations: 攻击成功率依赖提示工程，随模型更新脆弱；出站请求的可观测性（如代理日志）可被用于检测，文中未评估此类防御；真实聊天机器人样本量小。

title: SoK: Decentralized Agent Economic Infrastructure
abstract: Decentralized agent economies increasingly build a single task from protocols that were designed and secured separately. This creates a simple problem: a workflow can look correct at each step and still produce the wrong outcome. For example, a correct escrow may release payment on an authorized approval that provides little evidence that the delivered work actually satisfied the task. We systematize this problem across the full lifecycle of an agent task. Our study organizes security and economic requirements into 17 property families over six stages, with receipt soundness and completeness assessed separately. We examine 12 systems and standards, five reusable mechanism families, and four classical baselines. We introduce guarantee closure, a task-relative criterion for determining whether guarantees established at one stage remain available and constrain the later decisions that depend on them. We apply the criterion to controlled and native workflows, covering 840 matched executions and an exhaustive 11,648-case check over a finite objective-task domain. Our results expose recurring failures between verification and settlement, where conforming work can remain unaccepted or valid evidence can be ignored. Public records and model judgments further distinguish recorded approval from evidence of task conformance, while economic analysis identifies the report, penalty, and shared-error assumptions behind these guarantees. These findings show where end-to-end guarantees fail and what must be repaired to preserve them across the workflow.
title_cn: SoK：去中心化智能体经济基础设施
abstract_cn: 去中心化智能体经济日益把单个任务构建在各自被独立设计与安全加固的协议之上。这造成一个简单问题：工作流可以在每一步看似正确、却产生错误结果。例如，一个正确的托管可以在「授权批准」上释放付款，而该批准几乎没有证据表明交付的工作实际满足了任务。我们把该问题系统化到智能体任务的完整生命周期：研究把安全与经济要求组织为六个阶段上的 17 个性质族，回执的健全性与完备性被分别评估。我们考察 12 个系统与标准、五个可复用机制族与四个经典基线。我们引入「保证闭包」——一个任务相对的判据，用于确定在一个阶段建立的保证是否保持可用并约束依赖它的后续决策。我们把该判据应用于受控与原生工作流，覆盖 840 次匹配执行与对有限目标任务域的穷尽 11,648 案例检查。结果暴露「验证与结算之间」的反复失败：合规工作可能不被接受、有效证据可能被忽略。公共记录与模型判断进一步区分「被记录的批准」与「任务符合性的证据」，经济分析识别这些保证背后的报告、惩罚与共享错误假设。这些发现指明端到端保证在哪里失效、以及为跨工作流保全它们需要修复什么。
summary_cn: 系统化去中心化智能体经济基础设施：六阶段 17 性质族与「保证闭包」判据，检视 12 系统与 5 机制族；840 次匹配执行+11,648 案例穷尽检查暴露验证-结算间的反复失败。
objective_summary: 以六阶段 17 性质族系统化智能体经济协议，提出保证闭包判据并在受控工作流、840 匹配执行与 11,648 案例穷尽检查上定位端到端保证失效点。
evidence_note: 12 系统的系统化+受控执行与穷尽检查的量化分析；目标任务域为有限构造，非真实市场数据；无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把智能体经济基础设施作为安全对象系统化的首批工作之一，「保证闭包」给出跨阶段推理的新判据。
scope: 结论适用于以托管/回执/结算组合任务的去中心化智能体系统；判据的任务相对性意味着需逐任务实例化；链下法律与身份层未覆盖。
limitations: 有限目标任务域上的穷尽检查不等于开放任务域的保证；12 系统快照可能快速过时；修复建议未在真实系统中验证。

title: The Achilles' Heel of Partial Reconfiguration: Optical Side-Channel Leakage on the 7-Series ICAP
abstract: Major FPGA manufacturers have incorporated bitstream encryption to protect sensitive configuration data. However, for the most widely used FPGA families, multiple attacks against unpatchable protection schemes hard-wired into the devices can bypass or fully break them, making patchable schemes desirable. In this work, we present a proof-of-concept implementation of an AMD-proposed asymmetric key encryption scheme for bitstream protection for 7-Series FPGAs, using partial reconfiguration from the Programmable Logic. We analyze the security implications and hardware overhead of this implementation. We then propose and demonstrate an optical side-channel attack that is able to recover plain-text configuration data during the dynamic reconfiguration process. This attack leverages Photon Emission Microscopy and Electro-Optical Probing to first locate and then contactlessly extract the plain-text data from the ICAP interface, which internally connects the Programmable Logic with the configuration logic. We located the ICAP buses in an AMD XC7A200T device and show that the data on it can be extracted with Electro-Optical Probing. We claim that even advanced encryption schemes utilizing Partial Reconfiguration and custom cryptographic engines are vulnerable to optical attacks, as reconfiguration is only possible via hard-wired, vulnerable configuration interfaces.
comment: Accepted for publication in the 29th Euromicro Conference on Digital System Design (DSD 2026)
title_cn: 部分重配置的阿喀琉斯之踵：7 系 ICAP 上的光学侧信道泄露
abstract_cn: 主要 FPGA 厂商已引入比特流加密以保护敏感配置数据。但对最广泛使用的 FPGA 家族，针对硬连线到器件中、不可修补保护方案的多种攻击可以绕过或完全破解它们，使可修补方案成为期望。本工作给出 AMD 为 7 系列 FPGA 提出的非对称密钥比特流保护方案的原理验证实现——经由来自可编程逻辑的部分重配置，并分析其安全含义与硬件开销。随后我们提出并演示一种光学侧信道攻击，能在动态重配置过程中恢复明文配置数据。该攻击利用光子发射显微（PEM）与电光探测（EO）先定位再非接触式地从 ICAP 接口提取明文数据——该接口内部连接可编程逻辑与配置逻辑。我们在 AMD XC7A200T 器件上定位了 ICAP 总线，并展示其上的数据可通过电光探测提取。我们主张：即便采用部分重配置与定制密码引擎的先进加密方案，也易受光学攻击，因为重配置只能经由硬连线、脆弱的配置接口进行。（DSD 2026 接收）
summary_cn: 实现 7 系列 FPGA 非对称比特流保护的 PoC 后，演示光学侧信道攻击：以 PEM 定位、电光探测从 XC7A200T 的 ICAP 总线非接触提取动态重配置中的明文配置数据（DSD 2026）。
objective_summary: 在 7 系列 FPGA 上实现经部分重配置的非对称比特流保护方案，并以光子发射显微与电光探测演示对 ICAP 接口的明文提取攻击。
evidence_note: 真实器件（XC7A200T）上的物理攻击演示，含定位与提取全链路；单一器件、原理验证，未覆盖家族全部型号与防护变体。
novelty_note: 把光学攻击面扩展到部分重配置路径上的 ICAP 明文，揭示「可修补加密仍经脆弱硬连线接口」的结构性问题；光学探针技术本身已有。
scope: 结论适用于 7 系列及采用类似硬连线配置接口的 FPGA；攻击需物理接近与实验室级设备（PEM/EO）；对在配置接口外实施加密的方案不适用。
limitations: 原理验证限于单一器件与所测重配置流程；设备成本与操作复杂度高，威胁现实性需按场景评估；未评估检测/屏蔽对策。

title: Combining Homomorphic Encryption and Differential Privacy in Federated Learning for Model Inspection and Availability
abstract: The increasing prevalence of decentralized data has led to a growing interest in federated learning, which enables collaborative model training without clients sharing their sensitive local data. However, FL alone does not sufficiently protect sensitive training data and is generally coupled with privacy-preserving techniques, such as differential privacy and homomorphic encryption. Although powerful, these techniques address separate concerns via different mechanisms, so relying on just one might prove insufficient or impractical for addressing challenges associated with federated learning. In this work, we propose a privacy-preserving federated learning framework that combines homomorphic encryption-based training with differential privacy-based model inspection and release. We adopt a Markov chain Monte Carlo-based Bayesian privacy estimation method to estimate the privacy of our proposed framework. Our results show that this method improves both model utility and estimated privacy over the baseline method that relies solely on differential privacy for training. In our experiments with the FEMNIST dataset, by the end of training, our method reaches a test loss of $1.09$, compared to $2.37$ for the differential privacy-only approach, while providing stronger estimated privacy protection, with the estimated posterior mean of the privacy parameter $\epsilon$ of $4.32$, compared to $7.26$ for the differential privacy-only approach. We also show that intermittent model monitoring can preserve the encrypted training trajectory while, under our evaluated experimental setting, providing estimated privacy comparable to or stronger than the differential privacy-only approach.
title_cn: 联邦学习中同态加密与差分隐私的结合：模型检查与可用性
abstract_cn: 去中心化数据的增多引发对联邦学习（FL）的兴趣：无需客户端共享敏感本地数据即可协作训练模型。但 FL 本身不足以充分保护敏感训练数据，通常需与差分隐私、同态加密等隐私保护技术耦合。这些技术强大但经由不同机制处理不同问题，只依赖其一可能不足以或不实际地应对联邦学习相关挑战。本文提出一个隐私保护联邦学习框架，把基于同态加密的训练与基于差分隐私的模型检查与发布结合。我们采用基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛的贝叶斯隐私估计方法估计所提框架的隐私。结果显示，与仅依赖差分隐私训练的基线方法相比，该方法同时改善模型效用与估计隐私：在 FEMNIST 数据集实验中，训练结束时我们的方法测试损失达 1.09，差分隐私方法为 2.37，同时提供更强的估计隐私保护——隐私参数 ε 的估计后验均值为 4.32，差分隐私方法为 7.26。我们还表明间歇性模型监控可以在加密训练轨迹得以保留的同时，在所评估实验设置下提供与差分隐私方法相当或更强的估计隐私。
summary_cn: 提出 HE 训练+DP 检查/发布的联邦学习框架，用 MCMC 贝叶斯方法估计隐私：FEMNIST 上测试损失 1.09 对 DP-only 的 2.37，估计 ε 后验均值 4.32 对 7.26，兼顾效用与估计隐私。
objective_summary: 构建同态加密训练与差分隐私模型检查/发布结合的联邦学习框架，用 MCMC 贝叶斯隐私估计在 FEMNIST 上与 DP-only 基线比较损失与 ε 估计。
evidence_note: FEMNIST 上的对照实验与贝叶斯隐私估计的量化对比；单一数据集、「估计隐私」非形式 ε-DP 证明，无统计检验。
novelty_note: HE+DP 组合在联邦学习中已有研究；增量在于 MCMC 隐私估计流程与间歇监控调度；框架整合性质强于机制创新。
scope: 结论限于 FEMNIST 规模与所评估实验设置；「估计隐私」为贝叶斯后验而非形式 ε-DP 保证；对更大模型与跨站点（silo）异构场景未验证。
limitations: 贝叶斯隐私估计本身的校准性未验证；HE 开销在大模型上的可扩展性未报告；间歇监控调度的隐私累积未严格分析。

title: Protocol Integration of Physical Layer Deception into EAP-TEAP Wi-Fi Authentication
abstract: Credential-based Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP) authentication cannot distinguish a legitimate credential holder from an adversary using compromised credentials. Physical Layer Deception (PLD) complements credential-based authentication by exposing a deceptive primary object over a primary transport while a separate recovery object travels with differentiated reliability over a secondary channel. Existing PLD studies remain, to our knowledge, at the physical/link-model level; using PLD's activation/deactivation mechanism as an authentication gate creates an authentication-specific design requirement, since an all-inactive attempt would exercise no recovery path. We present a batched PLD-based re-verification step for Enterprise Wi-Fi's TEAP/RADIUS/IEEE 802.11 authentication chain, implemented end to end across the server, access point, and device in the open-source hostap 2.12 codebase. Each attempt carries three rounds, at least one active, with no dedicated activation flag. Across four campaigns totaling 1593 attempts, the prototype evaluates batched recovery behavior, rejects the implemented naive credential-bearing attacker in all 30 attempts, measures successful-path latency, and evaluates the security-reliability trade-off for one, two, and three active rounds under two modeled recovery regimes. The evaluation exercises the protocol and software-MAC behavior directly and analyzes informed and retry-seeking attackers under the software recovery model.
title_cn: 物理层欺骗与 EAP-TEAP Wi-Fi 认证的协议集成
abstract_cn: 基于凭证的可扩展认证协议（EAP）认证无法区分合法凭证持有者与使用被盗凭证的对手。物理层欺骗（PLD）通过在主传输上暴露一个欺骗性主对象、同时在辅助信道上以差异化可靠性传输独立恢复对象，来补充基于凭证的认证。据我们所知，现有 PLD 研究仍停留在物理/链路模型层面；把 PLD 的激活/去活机制用作认证门会产生认证特有的设计要求，因为全不活跃的尝试不会行使任何恢复路径。我们为企业 Wi-Fi 的 TEAP/RADIUS/IEEE 802.11 认证链提出一个批处理式的基于 PLD 的再验证步骤，在开源 hostap 2.12 代码库中跨服务器、接入点与设备端到端实现。每次尝试携带三轮（至少一轮活跃），无专用激活标志。在共 1,593 次尝试的四个战役中，原型评估了批处理恢复行为、在全部 30 次尝试中拒绝所实现的朴素凭证携带攻击者、测量成功路径延迟，并评估一轮、两轮与三轮活跃在两种建模恢复机制下的安全-可靠性权衡。评估直接演练协议与软件 MAC 行为，并在软件恢复模型下分析知情的与寻求重试的攻击者。
summary_cn: 把物理层欺骗（PLD）作为再验证步骤端到端集成进 hostap 2.12 的 TEAP/RADIUS/802.11 认证链：1,593 次尝试四战役，30/30 拒绝朴素凭证攻击者，并量化 1–3 活跃轮的安全-可靠性权衡与延迟。
objective_summary: 在 hostap 2.12 中实现 PLD 批处理再验证并接入企业 Wi-Fi 认证链，通过四个战役测量恢复行为、对朴素攻击者的拒绝率与轮数配置的权衡。
evidence_note: 端到端开源实现（hostap 2.12）+1,593 次实测尝试+多轮权衡量化；攻击者模型以朴素凭证重放为主，知情攻击者为软件模型分析而非实测。
novelty_note: PLD 是作者先前技术，本文贡献在其协议级集成与工程验证；认证门设计要求（全不活跃尝试）是增量性的规范贡献。
scope: 结论适用于可控物理层传输的企业 Wi-Fi 部署与 hostap 类软件栈；恢复机制为软件建模，硬件射频差异未覆盖；对能操控物理层的强对手保证有限。
limitations: 仅 30 次的攻击者测试规模小；PLD 依赖收发设备支持，通用客户端可用性存疑；真实射频环境与移动性的现场试验缺失。

title: Chaining Skills to Hijack LLM Agents
abstract: LLM agents use skills to improve performance on specialized tasks. To complete a user request, an agent may invoke several skills in sequence, allowing information produced under one skill to guide the next. Because skills may come from open-source repositories, this handoff can also carry attacker-controlled claims into later decisions. In this paper, we introduce APEX, which constructs and refines adversarial skill chains tailored to a user task and an attacker-selected action. The key insight is that an agent-written record of genuine task progress can carry a false claim of user approval across skills: an upstream skill induces the agent to create the record, and a downstream skill uses it to direct the attacker-selected action. Across four targeted-action families and six models on SkillsBench, the chains induce the selected action in 512 of 690 attempts (74.2%). On GPT-5.4, the full chain succeeds in 84.3% of attempts, compared with 17.4% when the workflow is merged into one skill. We further evaluate a prompting defense that asks the agent to check skill-produced files against the original request. On GPT-5.4, it lowers targeted-action success from 84.3% to 59.1%, while the verifier test-pass rate across 72 benign native-skill tasks falls from 86.7% to 56.3%. These results highlight the need for defenses that prevent attacker-directed actions while preserving legitimate task performance.
title_cn: 链接技能以劫持 LLM 智能体
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体使用技能来提升专门任务的性能。为完成用户请求，智能体可能按序调用多个技能，使在一个技能下产生的信息引导下一个。由于技能可能来自开源仓库，这种交接也可能把攻击者控制的声明带进后续决策。本文提出 APEX：为用户任务与攻击者选定的动作构造并精炼对抗性技能链。关键洞察是：智能体写下的真实任务进展记录可以携带跨技能的虚假用户批准声明——上游技能诱导智能体创建该记录，下游技能利用它指导攻击者选定的动作。在 SkillsBench 上跨四个定向动作族与六个模型，技能链在 690 次尝试中的 512 次（74.2%）诱导选定动作。在 GPT-5.4 上，完整链在 84.3% 的尝试中成功，而把工作流合并为单技能时仅 17.4%。我们进一步评估一种提示防御——要求智能体把技能产生的文件与原始请求核对。在 GPT-5.4 上，它把定向动作成功从 84.3% 降到 59.1%，而 72 个良性原生技能任务上的验证器通过率从 86.7% 降到 56.3%。这些结果凸显：需要既能阻止攻击者定向动作、又保持合法任务性能的防御。
summary_cn: 提出对抗技能链 APEX：上游技能写入的「真实进展记录」夹带伪造用户批准被下游技能采信——四动作族六模型上 74.2% 诱导成功（GPT-5.4 全链 84.3% 对单技能 17.4%）；提示防御降至 59.1% 但良性通过率 86.7%→56.3%。
objective_summary: 构造利用跨技能交接记录夹带虚假批准的攻击框架 APEX，在 SkillsBench 上量化链式与合并式的成功率差异，并测量提示防御的攻防权衡。
evidence_note: 四动作族×六模型×690 次尝试、链式/合并对照与防御效用代价量化；自建 SkillsBench 评测，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 揭示「真实进展记录+伪造批准」的跨技能信任交接漏洞，把技能生态的供应链风险具体化为可测量攻击；链式利用是实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于从外部仓库装载多技能、技能间共享工作区记录的智能体；对无共享状态的技能架构不适用；防御评估限于提示级方案。
limitations: 提示防御仅降至 59.1% 且显著伤及良性任务；攻击构造依赖技能产出可被下游读取的格式；对运行时溯源/签名类防御未评估。

title: False Floors: LLM Safety Routing Evaluations Break Under Distribution Shift
abstract: Safety routers send each request to one of several models and are judged against the best single model. A major routing benchmark picks that comparator on the evaluation data. In the benchmark's own setting this is harmless, but under distribution shift it is not. On HELM Safety the selection cost is 0.003-0.030 of harm under random splits and 0.045-0.113 under held-out categories, comparable to the whole deficit attributed to routing, with its direction holding under either published judge alone. It rises seven- to ninefold on AgentDojo when suites are held out. Across seven safety corpora chosen by rules fixed in advance, three meet a registered interval test and four beat a later permutation null, and three of the four interval misses are corpora where some models have zero observed harm. Prior work proves the direction of this bias. We size it on harm and accuracy, show that it is larger under the held-out splits we measure, and bound it by optimism plus a shift-dependent regret. Scored honestly under shift, routing buys little on these benchmarks. In most pool cells the nested router serves the honest baseline's model, and on the nearly saturated AgentDojo corpus a perfect pre-dispatch router is worth at most two points of harm. We also find a model's expressed recognition of a late injection steerable. On held-out reruns an attacker who knows which model it faces lowers GPT-5.4's judged recognition by 19.6 points, confirmed by an independent label. In an offline counterfactual composition into a controller, the same attack raises or lowers estimated harm depending on the fallback model. Safety routing should be evaluated under shift, against a baseline chosen without the test labels, and recognition-based defences should be scored on harm against an attacker who chooses what the model sees.
title_cn: 虚假地板：LLM 安全路由评估在分布偏移下崩塌
abstract_cn: 安全路由器把每个请求发给多个模型之一，并以最佳单一模型为基准受评判。一个主要路由基准是在评测数据上挑选该比较者。在基准自身设定中无害，但在分布偏移下则不然。在 HELM Safety 上，选择成本在随机分割下为危害的 0.003–0.030，在留出类别下为 0.045–0.113，与归因于路由的全部缺口相当，且方向在任一已发布评审下都成立；当按套件留出时在 AgentDojo 上上升七到九倍。在按预先固定规则选定的七个安全语料上，三个通过注册的区间检验、四个胜过事后置换零假设，而四个区间未过的语料中有三个存在某些模型零观测危害。先前工作已证明该偏差的方向；我们在危害与准确率上测量其大小，表明在我们测量的留出分割下更大，并以乐观度加偏移依赖遗憾为其定界。在偏移下诚实计分时，路由在这些基准上收益甚微：在多数池单元中嵌套路由器服务的正是诚实基线的模型，而在接近饱和的 AgentDojo 语料上，完美的预派发路由器至多值两个危害点。我们还发现模型对迟来注入的「表达识别」可被操纵：在留出重跑中，知道面对哪个模型的攻击者把 GPT-5.4 的被评识别降低 19.6 点（经独立标签确认）；在到控制器的离线反事实组合中，同一攻击依据回退模型升高或降低估计危害。安全路由应在偏移下、以不经测试标签选择的基准评估；基于识别的防御应以「对手选择模型所见内容」下的危害计分。
summary_cn: 证明安全路由基准以测试数据选比较者导致乐观偏置：HELM Safety 上选择成本在留出类别下达危害的 0.045–0.113，诚实计分下路由收益甚微；针对性攻击可把 GPT-5.4 的识别评分压低 19.6 点。
objective_summary: 量化安全路由评估中比较者选择偏差在分布偏移下的规模（含注册检验与置换零假设），并测量针对识别信号的操纵攻击对路由组合的危害估计影响。
evidence_note: 预注册式区间检验、置换零假设、独立标签确认与七语料系统量化；对已发布基准的方法学审计，证据链完整。
novelty_note: 对主流路由基准的偏差做定量修正并给出防御评估的反事实计分建议；偏差方向已有理论，本文贡献在测量与操纵攻击。
scope: 结论适用于以测试数据选比较者的路由/安全基准与 HELM Safety、AgentDojo 等所测语料；识别操纵实验限于 GPT-5.4 与所测评审。
limitations: 七个语料仍属可用基准集合，非全域证明；操纵攻击在离线反事实组合中评估而非端到端路由系统；评审模型依赖性未完全消除。

title: OverAct: Measuring and Mitigating Proactive Over-Authorization in LLM Tool-Calling Agents
abstract: LLM agents with tool-calling capabilities can access external services and private user data, but they may retrieve more information than a user's request explicitly requires. We study this behavior in structured tool-calling agents and term it proactive over-authorization. This setting differs from filesystem-level coding agents because the main risk is unnecessary access to private data. We introduce OverAct, a controlled benchmark spanning eight privacy-sensitive domains with deterministic, judge-free scoring, together with an interpretive decision-theoretic framework that yields three testable predictions. Across seven models from four families, all models significantly exceed authorized scope. Request specificity is the strongest predictor of severity, over-authorization grows sublinearly with tool-pool size, and decoding temperature has little effect. These patterns are consistent with a cost-asymmetry account, suggesting that over-authorization arises more from structural decision tendencies than from decoding randomness. We also propose SelfAudit, a zero-shot inference-time method that generates request-grounded justifications and filters unjustified calls before execution. Ablation shows that explicit filtering is the main driver of scope reduction. SelfAudit reduces privacy-oriented excess by 43% without oracle knowledge.
title_cn: OverAct：测量与缓解 LLM 工具调用智能体的主动越权
abstract_cn: 具备工具调用能力的 LLM 智能体可以访问外部服务与私密用户数据，但它们可能检索超出用户请求明确要求的信息。我们在结构化工具调用智能体中研究该行为并称之为主动越权。该设定不同于文件系统级编码智能体，因为主要风险是对私密数据的不必要访问。我们引入 OverAct，一个覆盖八个隐私敏感域、具有确定性免评审打分的受控基准，以及一个产生三个可检验预测的决策论解释框架。跨四个族的七个模型，所有模型都显著超出授权范围；请求特异性是严重程度的最强预测因子，越权随工具池规模次线性增长，解码温度几乎没有影响。这些模式与成本不对称解释一致，表明越权更多源于结构性决策倾向而非解码随机性。我们进一步提出 SelfAudit，一个零样本推理时方法：生成基于请求的正当理由并在执行前过滤不合理的调用。消融显示显式过滤是范围缩减的主要驱动。SelfAudit 在无先验知识的情况下把隐私导向的越权减少 43%。
summary_cn: 提出主动越权基准 OverAct（8 域、确定性打分）：4 族 7 模型全部显著越权，请求特异性是最强预测因子、温度几乎无影响；推理时 SelfAudit 以请求正当性过滤把隐私越权减少 43%。
objective_summary: 构建测量工具调用智能体超出请求授权范围访问行为的受控基准，跨模型验证三个决策论预测，并提出执行前自我审计过滤方法 SelfAudit。
evidence_note: 8 域×7 模型的受控基准、确定性免评审打分、三预测检验与消融；「显著超出」暗示统计检验但细节未披露；无真实用户数据。
novelty_note: 把智能体风险从「被攻击越权」转向「主动越权」这一此前未被基准化的行为并给出决策论解释；新问题形式化是主要贡献。
scope: 结论适用于结构化工具调用智能体与可枚举授权域；打分依赖请求授权范围的规格方式；对话式模糊请求场景未覆盖。
limitations: 授权范围由基准定义，可能与真实用户意图有偏差；SelfAudit 的过滤依赖模型自我正当化质量；对自适应提示诱导越权的评估未报告。

title: Key-Reuse Vulnerability of Phase-Keyed Fourier-Curve Modulation: Relation Leakage and Key-Refresh Cost on Coded Links
abstract: The security of keyed modulation is often argued from the key-space size and the error rate of a key-less receiver. This evidence fails when the key is reused and the waveform is harmonically coupled. For a phase-keyed Fourier-curve constellation, whose $k$ tones share one data parameter, integer relations among the harmonic indices yield data-cancelling mixed moments of the received tones that expose key characters. A modular relation lattice characterizes the exposed characters; for consecutive harmonics, third-order moments recover the relative phases and a fourth-order moment completes the key up to cyclic relabeling whenever its coefficient is nonzero, as in all evaluated settings. A non-data-aided relation-moment estimator turns this leakage into an attack that never enumerates the key space. On a regular $(3,6)$ LDPC-coded link, one key per 168-symbol codeword leaves the eavesdropper a block error rate below $0.04$ at the middle noise level, and the attack meets a predeclared $0.1$ compromise criterion in eleven of twelve operating points. Tangent artificial noise and a harmonic set without relations below order four raise her measured error rate at intermediate reuse lengths but do not remove the one-codeword vulnerability. For a grid of $2^{128}$ protocol keys at the middle noise level, equal-length refresh schedules that keep a $95\%$ lower confidence bound of her block error rate above $0.9$ consume at least $1.52$ fresh key bits per information bit, $1.52$ times the entropy rate of a one-time pad on the data.
comment: Submitted to IEEE for publication
title_cn: 相位键控傅里叶曲线调制的密钥重用漏洞：关系泄露与编码链路上的密钥刷新成本
abstract_cn: 键控调制的安全性常从密钥空间大小与无密钥接收机的错误率论证。当密钥被重用且波形谐波耦合时，这些证据失效。对相位键控傅里叶曲线星座——其 k 个音共享一个数据参数——谐波索引间的整数关系会产生使接收音数据抵消的混合矩，暴露密钥字符。模关系格刻画了被暴露的字符；对连续谐波，三阶矩恢复相对相位，四阶矩在其系数非零时（如所有被评估设置）完成至循环重标记的密钥恢复。非数据辅助的关系矩估计器把该泄露转化为从不枚举密钥空间的攻击。在正则 (3,6) LDPC 编码链路上，每 168 符号码字一个密钥使窃听者在中等噪声水平的块错误率低于 0.04，攻击在十二个工作点中的十一个达到预声明的 0.1 危及判据。切向人工噪声与无四阶以下关系的谐波集在中短重用长度提高其测量错误率，但不消除单码字漏洞。对中等噪声水平下 2¹²⁸ 的协议密钥网格，把其块错误率 95% 置信下界保持在 0.9 以上的等长刷新调度每信息比特至少消耗 1.52 个新密钥比特——是数据一次性密钥熵率的 1.52 倍。
summary_cn: 揭示相位键控傅里叶曲线调制在密钥重用下的关系矩泄露：三/四阶矩可恢复密钥（12 工作点中 11 个越过 0.1 危及判据），人工噪声与谐波选择不根除；安全刷新需 1.52 密钥比特/信息比特。
objective_summary: 刻画谐波整数关系导致的密钥字符泄露并构造非数据辅助关系矩攻击，在 LDPC 编码链路上量化不同重用长度与缓解措施的危及率及刷新成本。
evidence_note: 编码链路仿真、12 个工作点、预声明判据与 95% 置信下界的定量评估；物理层仿真而非实测，攻击限于该调制族。
novelty_note: 系统刻画该键控调制族的谐波关系泄露并给出密钥刷新成本的量化下界；对「密钥空间大小≠重用安全」的论证有普遍警示价值。
scope: 结论适用于 k 音共享单数据参数、谐波指数存在整数关系的键控调制；缓解评估限于切向人工噪声与谐波集选择；不覆盖其他星座设计。
limitations: 结论基于仿真链路与理想化信道模型；攻击要求可积累多码字观测；密钥刷新成本下界依赖其置信界定义。

title: Robust and leakage-resilient device-independent oblivious transfer in MiniQCryp
abstract: Assuming post-quantum one-way functions, we construct device-independent (DI) oblivious transfer (OT) and bit commitment: honest parties use only trusted classical computation to operate untrusted quantum devices, which may share arbitrary entanglement and behave non-IID. Security is simulation-based against quantum polynomial-time adversaries and composes sequentially with efficient simulators. One protocol skeleton serves both, in two regimes. With isolated laboratories and coordinate-local measurements in the honest receiver's device, it tolerates a constant rate of honest-device faults. With polylogarithmically many qubits of adaptive leakage between the laboratories and arbitrary joint measurements, it tolerates an inverse-polylogarithmic rate. Each elementary DI call uses a fresh, isolated batch of polylogarithmically many device coordinates, and total device use in the compiled OT protocol is polynomial. The commitment has efficient simulators against both parties and yields DI coin tossing with abort. Because OT is complete for secure computation, the construction yields a DI protocol, with abort, for every efficiently computable classical functionality on a fixed number of parties, secure against static corruption of any proper subset of them. The commitment's extractor changes a public parity relation through classical equivocation and leaves the device execution, hence its leakage, unchanged. A commit-and-prove functionality, disjoint audits, and an affine consistency check link the certified correlations to ideal OT. Sender security rests on a selector-aware parallel-repetition bound for the Magic Square game, which we derive from the two-round threshold theorem of Kundu and Tan.
title_cn: MiniQCryp 中鲁棒且抗泄露的设备无关不经意传输
abstract_cn: 假设后量子单向函数存在，我们构造设备无关（DI）不经意传输（OT）与比特承诺：诚实方仅用可信经典计算操作不可信量子设备，这些设备可共享任意纠缠且行为非独立同分布。安全性是模拟式的，抗量子多项式时间对手，并带高效模拟器顺序复合。一个协议骨架在两种机制下服务两者：在隔离实验室与诚实接收方设备的坐标局域测量下，它容忍常数率的诚实设备故障；在实验室间有多对数数量子比特的自适应泄露与任意联合测量下，它容忍逆多对数率的故障。每次基本 DI 调用使用一批新鲜的、隔离的多对数数量设备坐标，编译后的 OT 协议总设备使用量为多项式。承诺对双方都有高效模拟器，并给出带中止的 DI 掷币。由于 OT 对安全计算是完全的，该构造给出对每个可高效计算的经典功能、固定参与方数、抗任意真子集静态腐化、带中止的 DI 协议。承诺的提取器经由经典含糊化改变一个公共奇偶关系，同时保持设备执行（因而其泄露）不变。承诺-证明功能、不相交审计与仿射一致性检查把认证的关联与理想 OT 连接。发送方安全性依赖魔方博弈的选择器感知并行重复界，我们从 Kundu 与 Tan 的两轮阈值定理导出它。
summary_cn: 构造抗故障与抗泄露的 DI 不经意传输+比特承诺：模拟式安全、顺序复合，常数率设备故障或逆多对数泄露率下仍安全；由 OT 完全性得任意经典功能的 DI 协议，发送方安全性基于新的选择器感知并行重复界。
objective_summary: 在后量子单向函数假设下构造统一骨架的 DI OT 与承诺，容忍设备故障与自适应泄露，给出模拟式安全证明并经 OT 完全性获得通用 DI 安全计算。
evidence_note: 完整模拟式安全证明、双机制定量容错率（常数率故障/逆多对数泄露）、多项式设备使用界；理论工作的证据为证明完备性与定量参数。
novelty_note: 把 DI OT 推进到容忍诚实设备故障与自适应泄露的鲁棒机制，并给出统一骨架与新的并行重复界；DI 密码学方向的实质推进。
scope: 结论在后量子单向函数假设与设备坐标可隔离批处理的模型内成立；泄露模型限于实验室间多对数量子比特；未处理噪声物理设备的具体实现差距。
limitations: 设备使用量多项式但常数大，实际实现遥远；静态腐化假设（非自适应腐化）；选择器感知并行重复界的条件依赖魔方博弈结构。

title: Evidence Coverage for Intent-Bound Execution: Scope, Obligations, and Cutoff Reasoning
abstract: A verifier may authenticate every available record and still lack grounds to call an execution account complete. Such a claim requires a justified account of which records were due for the execution being assessed. We present an analytical model for retrospective coverage of declared execution-evidence obligations. Its scope binds a structured Intent, an exact Candidate, a selected analytical attempt, an execution and evidence boundary, a stage horizon, a fixed record-obligation profile, a named verifier, and an assessment cutoff. Branch and trigger premises determine obligation instances; source competence, content, integrity, and object and stage bindings determine admissibility. We distinguish closure of the obligation inventory from closure of the relevant verifier view, and define three reporting results: COMPLETE_WITHIN_SCOPE, INCOMPLETE, and UNKNOWN. These results concern current coverage of obligations due at the cutoff. Execution progress, external outcome knowledge, and historical delivery timeliness are reported separately. Constructed service-principal-disablement cases demonstrate complete dispatch and refusal branches, a due but missing final-result record, subsequent coverage after late delivery, and the limits of extending one selected attempt's coverage to all attempts. The contribution is an execution-specific composition of scope, branch, horizon, obligations, admissibility, view, and cutoff. Completeness remains conditional on the declared profile and assessment premises.
title_cn: 意图绑定执行的证据覆盖：范围、义务与截止推理
abstract_cn: 一个验证器可以认证所有可用记录，却仍缺乏把某个执行账目称为完备的依据。这样的声明需要对「哪些记录对被评估的执行是到期的」给出有据说明。我们提出一个用于回溯性覆盖所声明执行证据义务的分析模型。其范围把结构化意图、精确候选、所选分析尝试、执行与证据边界、阶段视界、固定记录义务画像、具名验证器与评估截止绑定在一起。分支与触发前提决定义务实例；来源胜任性、内容、完整性以及对象与阶段绑定决定可采性。我们区分义务清单的闭合与相关验证器视图的闭合，并定义三种报告结果：COMPLETE_WITHIN_SCOPE、INCOMPLETE 与 UNKNOWN。这些结果针对截止时到期义务的当前覆盖；执行进度、外部结果知识与历史送达及时性被单独报告。构造的服务主体停用案例演示了完整的分发与拒绝分支、一个到期但缺失的最终结果记录、迟送达后的后续覆盖，以及把一次所选尝试的覆盖扩展到所有尝试的限度。贡献是执行特定的范围、分支、视界、义务、可采性、视图与截止的组合。完备性始终以所声明的画像与评估前提为条件。
summary_cn: 提出回溯审计执行证据义务的分析模型：以意图/候选/边界/视界/画像/截止限定范围，输出 COMPLETE_WITHIN_SCOPE/INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN 三态，并以服务主体停用案例演示覆盖判定及其限度。
objective_summary: 定义意图绑定执行的证据覆盖分析模型（范围、义务实例、可采性、三态报告），并用构造案例演示分支覆盖与迟送达场景。
evidence_note: 纯概念模型：仅构造性案例演示，无实现、无数据集、无实证评估；完备性声明自陈以画像与前提为条件。
novelty_note: 为智能体执行审计补足「证据覆盖」这一记账性概念；模型为既有审计/义务概念的组合形式化，系列式工作的一环。
scope: 适用于以结构化意图与记录义务可枚举为前提的执行审计；不覆盖对抗性证据伪造或验证器自身被攻陷；结果语义限于截止时点。
limitations: 无任何实现验证；义务画像需人工声明，遗漏声明即系统性盲区；与真实审计工具的衔接未讨论。

title: Is it Possible to Generate Irreversible PolyProtected Templates from Face Embeddings using System-Specific Keys?
abstract: This work aims to answer the question of whether it is possible to generate irreversible protected templates when the PolyProtect biometric template protection method is applied to face embeddings using system-specific keys (i.e., the same C and E parameters, which define the transform, are applied to all subjects' face embeddings), instead of the traditional subject-specific keys (i.e., each subject has their own C and E parameters). This is important for determining whether we can perform de-duplication of face identities in the PolyProtected domain, which is not possible in the subject-specific key scenario due to the clash with PolyProtect's unlinkability property (i.e., one could generate multiple protected templates belonging to the same identity, using different C and E parameters, such that those templates cannot be linked to each other). We present experiments (reproducible using our open-source code) to prove that there exist at least three ways of systematically selecting system-specific keys that produce irreversible PolyProtected templates: (i) from pre-selected subject-specific keys, (ii) by applying a previously proposed key selection algorithm to random vectors, and (iii) by approximating a "good" C/E pair distribution from which system-specific keys can be constructed. Our findings thus point to the conclusion that it is, indeed, possible to safely operate PolyProtect in the system-specific key scenario without degrading the template protection potential. This opens up the possibility for identity de-duplication in the PolyProtected domain.
