title_cn: 拒绝而不瘫痪：多智能体系统的授权配对评估与控制
abstract_cn: 多智能体系统的能力来自跨智能体共享证据、委托任务与组合信息。同一过程制造了安全问题：孤立可接纳的贡献合起来可能使被禁止的用途成为可能。阻止所有敏感动作可以避免泄露，却也废掉了协作的本意。我们引入授权配对评估：把「阻止被禁止用途」与「完成所需已授权用途」作为联合成功标准；并提出 FlowReview 框架，连接对象解析、权限排序与确定性执行。在受控组合实验中，审查组合工件把拒绝提交率从 86.0% 降到零，且不损失已授权供给。结果表明，仅保存信息与谱系并不保证正确的权限归属：对象身份与权限必须经由输出可验证的组件与执行保持连接。这些发现为多智能体安全确立了一个系统级要求：在治理组合信息流的同时，保全使协作有用的已授权能力。
summary_cn: 提出授权配对评估标准与 FlowReview 框架（对象解析+权限排序+确定性执行）：受控组合实验中拒绝提交率从 86.0% 降至 0 且已授权供给无损，指出组合信息流治理是多智能体安全的系统级要求。
objective_summary: 定义「阻止禁止用途+完成授权用途」的联合评估标准，构建连接对象解析、权限排序与确定性执行的 FlowReview 框架，并在受控组合实验中测量拒绝提交率与授权供给。
evidence_note: 受控组合实验报告 86.0%→0 与无损授权供给，代码数据公开；但实验设置与规模在摘要中披露有限，缺统计检验与外部基准对比。
novelty_note: 把多智能体安全的目标从单向阻止改为授权-禁止配对联合优化，并给出可验证组件的流水线设计；问题重构有新意，组件多为已有。
scope: 结论适用于可枚举对象与权限的多智能体工作流；权限排序的正确性依赖上游对象解析组件的可验证输出；对开放域自然语言通信场景未评估。
limitations: 受控实验外的真实工作流验证缺失；确定性执行可能不适配模糊权限判断；框架的对抗鲁棒性（如对象解析被欺骗）未评估。

title: Proof-Gated Signing: Solver-Checked Transaction Guards that Hold Under State Drift for Onchain AI Agents
abstract: AI agents that control wallets read attacker-reachable content, so they can be steered into proposing harmful transactions. The usual last line of defense is a pre-signing check: a static allowlist, an LLM reviewer, or a transaction simulation. All three share a gap: the check describes the chain state at check time, but the transaction executes in a later state that an adversary can shape through front-running, contract upgrades or token-parameter changes. We call this state drift. We present Proof-Gated Signing (PGS), which simulates a proposed transaction, extracts its effects, and uses an SMT solver to check a declarative value-and-permission policy for every price in an oracle-uncertainty band. It then compiles on-chain post-conditions (wallet balance bounds, payee receipts, allowance caps and ownership) and proves that every execution satisfying them also satisfies the policy. The agent's smart-contract wallet enforces them atomically, so the guarantee applies to the executed transaction under arbitrary drift. On an open testbed of 260 scenarios (14 attack families including five drift and two adaptive families, and 12 benign families), with harm measured from attacker balances rather than from any policy, PGS prevented 93.6% of the 140 harmful scenarios and passed 97.5% of the benign ones. Simulation-only checking prevented 57.9% and a static allowlist 71.4%. None of the 50 drift scenarios produced attacker gain under PGS. The only unprevented family, an in-policy drain, was bounded by the per-session budget. We also find that giving an LLM reviewer a clean pre-drift simulation made it more likely to approve a drift attack. Overhead is about 41k gas and 0.1-0.2 s per check.
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: this https URL
title_cn: 证明门控签名：在状态漂移下依然成立的求解器校验交易守护，面向链上 AI 智能体
abstract_cn: 控制钱包的 AI 智能体会读取攻击者可达的内容，因此可能被诱导提出有害交易。通常的最后一道防线是签名前检查：静态白名单、LLM 审查者或交易模拟。三者共有同一缺口——检查描述的是检查时刻的链上状态，而交易在稍后执行，对手可通过抢跑、合约升级或代币参数改变塑造该状态。我们称之为状态漂移。我们提出证明门控签名（PGS）：模拟拟议交易、提取其效果，并用 SMT 求解器对预言机不确定带中的每个价格检查声明式价值与权限策略；随后编译链上后置条件（钱包余额界、收款人回执、授权上限与所有权），并证明每个满足后置条件的执行也满足策略。智能体的智能合约钱包原子地强制这些条件，因此保证适用于任意漂移下的实际执行交易。在 260 个场景的开放测试床上（14 个攻击族，含 5 个漂移族与 2 个自适应族，及 12 个良性族），危害从攻击者余额而非任何策略测量：PGS 阻止了 140 个有害场景中的 93.6%，并通过 97.5% 的良性场景；仅模拟检查阻止 57.9%，静态白名单 71.4%。50 个漂移场景无一在 PGS 下产生攻击者收益。唯一未阻止的族——策略内抽干——被会话预算约束。我们还发现，给 LLM 审查者一份干净的漂移前模拟反而使其更可能批准漂移攻击。开销约每次检查 41k gas 与 0.1–0.2 秒。
summary_cn: 针对链上智能体的状态漂移问题提出 PGS：SMT 校验预言机不确定带内的策略并编译链上后置条件由钱包原子强制；260 场景中阻止 93.6% 有害场景（模拟 57.9%、白名单 71.4%），50 个漂移场景零攻击者收益，开销约 41k gas。
objective_summary: 定义签名前检查的状态漂移缺口，提出模拟+SMT 策略校验+链上后置条件编译的证明门控签名机制，并在 260 场景（14 攻击族+12 良性族）开放测试床上与模拟检查、白名单及 LLM 审查对比。
evidence_note: 260 场景开放测试床、以攻击者余额定义危害、含漂移与自适应族及开销测量，代码数据公开；自建测试床、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把「检查时状态≠执行时状态」的漂移缺口形式化为链上智能体签名的核心威胁，并以可证明的后置条件桥接链下策略与链上强制；机制有实质新意。
scope: 适用于控制 EVM 类钱包、策略可表达为价值与权限约束的智能体；对预言机带外的价格操纵与策略内抽干只能靠预算上限约束；依赖智能合约钱包可原子强制后置条件。
limitations: 策略内危害（如被授权的抽干）不在阻止范围；41k gas 与 0.1–0.2 秒开销对高频交易可能过高；SMT 策略的表达力受限于可判定理论。

title: Fault-Tolerant Budget Conservation in Distributed Multi-Agent Delegation
abstract: Resource limits are becoming an authorization boundary for AI agents that delegate work across concurrent and failure-prone workers. Parent-child allocation constraints, affine objects, and distributed escrow do not by themselves prevent overspend when replies are lost, effects complete after timeout, messages repeat, branches partition, or DAG joins alias one lineage. We formalize fault-tolerant budget conservation for distributed multi-agent delegation. Budgets are quantized resource vectors represented by exclusive escrow credits that move through a delegation DAG. Before dispatch, a branch converts credit into an operation reservation bound to lineage, epoch, normalized effect, maximum charge, receiver, and idempotency key. It persists a signed dispatch permit with quarantine; the gateway verifies that permit before first acceptance. Uncertain effects remain charged until authenticated settlement, a fenced authoritative no-effect proof, or permanent retirement. We prove ownership partition, ledger and effect conservation, descendant non-amplification, at-most-once settlement, late-completion safety, and partition confinement under explicit mediation, durability, authentication, normalization, and gateway assumptions. An indistinguishability result shows that partition-local availability requires exclusive preallocation. Bounded TLA+ checking, an independent JavaScript explorer, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments exercise the declared scope and detect timeout-refund and historical-certificate-validation mutants. The mechanism preserves the issued budget bound across the evaluated crash, retry, duplicate, partition, join, and late-completion schedules.
comment: 67 pages, 3 figures, 17 tables, 4 algorithms, and 3 listings. Includes formal proofs, bounded model checking, mutation analysis, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments
title_cn: 分布式多智能体委托中的容错预算守恒
abstract_cn: 资源限额正在成为跨并发且易故障的 worker 委托工作的 AI 智能体的授权边界。亲子分配约束、仿射对象与分布式托管本身并不能在回复丢失、效果超时完成、消息重复、分支分区或 DAG 汇聚别名同一谱系时阻止超支。我们形式化分布式多智能体委托的容错预算守恒。预算是以独占托管信用表示的量化资源向量，沿委托 DAG 移动。分发前，分支把信用转换为绑定谱系、纪元、规范化效果、最大扣费、接收方与幂等键的操作保留；持久化带隔离区的签名分发许可，网关在首次接受前验证该许可。不确定的效果保持计费状态，直至认证结算、带围栏的权威无效果证明或永久退役。我们在显式中介、持久性、认证、规范化与网关假设下证明所有权划分、账本与效果守恒、后代不可放大、至多一次结算、迟到完成安全与分区围禁。一个不可区分性结果表明：分区局部可用性要求独占预分配。有界 TLA+ 检查、独立 JavaScript 探索器与注入崩溃的双进程 SQLite 实验演练了所声明的范围，并检出超时退款与历史证书验证突变体。该机制在所评估的崩溃、重试、重复、分区、汇聚与迟到完成调度下保持已发行预算界。
summary_cn: 形式化智能体委托 DAG 上的容错预算守恒：独占托管信用+签名分发许可+围栏结算，证明守恒/至多一次结算/分区围禁等性质；TLA+ 有界检查与崩溃注入 SQLite 实验，并证明分区局部可用性需要独占预分配。
objective_summary: 定义分布式多智能体委托中的预算守恒问题与托管信用机制（谱系绑定保留、签名许可、认证结算），证明守恒与围禁性质，并以 TLA+ 有界检查、独立探索器与崩溃注入实验验证。
evidence_note: TLA+ 有界模型检查、独立实现的探索器与崩溃注入双进程实验，含突变体检出；均为自建环境，无真实多智能体系统部署数据。
novelty_note: 把分布式系统的托管/围栏/幂等机制系统化地用于智能体委托预算并给出容错守恒证明；组件成熟，问题形式化与不可区分性结果是主要新意。
scope: 结论在显式中介、持久性、认证、规范化与网关假设下成立，适用于按量化资源向量建模预算的委托系统；不覆盖恶意网关与共谋接收方。
limitations: 假设网关可信且认证健全；不可区分性结果只给出必要方向；实验规模为双进程 SQLite，非真实分布式部署。

title: Removing the NEEDLE in the Haystack: Backdoor Removal in LLMs via Weight Orthogonalisation
abstract: Backdoor attacks can be implanted in Large Language Models (LLMs) during training, causing unwanted behaviour when a trigger appears in the input. Existing backdoor defences for LLMs attempt to remove the backdoor but inadvertently shift the model's output distribution to benign prompts, which can result in degraded model performance and safety. We propose NEEDLE, a training-free method for targeted backdoor removal. Once a trigger has been identified, our method estimates a backdoor direction and a refusal subspace through activation vectors, then applies sequential weight orthogonalisation to suppress the backdoor while preventing changes in refusal-related representations. NEEDLE requires neither a clean reference model nor the original poisoned training data. Evaluation is conducted across multiple model families and attack types. NEEDLE achieves the lowest mean Attack Success Rate (ASR) among the evaluated defences, including 0% on challenging code injection attacks, while resulting in the lowest KL divergence and minimal changes in capability and safety.
title_cn: 摘除干草堆中的针：基于权重正交化的 LLM 后门移除
abstract_cn: 后门攻击可在训练期间植入大语言模型（LLM），使模型在输入中出现触发器时产生不需要的行为。现有 LLM 后门防御试图移除后门，却会在无意中把模型在良性提示上的输出分布整体偏移，导致性能与安全性下降。我们提出 NEEDLE，一种免训练的定向后门移除方法。在触发器被识别后，该方法通过激活向量估计后门方向与拒绝子空间，然后施加顺序权重正交化，在抑制后门的同时阻止拒绝相关表示的改变。NEEDLE 既不需要干净参考模型，也不需要原始投毒训练数据。评估覆盖多个模型族与攻击类型：NEEDLE 在所评估防御中取得最低的平均攻击成功率（ASR），包括在具有挑战性的代码注入攻击上达到 0%，同时 KL 散度最低、能力与安全变化最小。
summary_cn: 提出免训练的 NEEDLE：由激活向量估计后门方向与拒绝子空间后做顺序权重正交化，无需干净模型或投毒数据；多族多攻击评估中平均 ASR 最低（代码注入 0%）且 KL 散度最小。
objective_summary: 提出通过激活向量估计后门方向与拒绝子空间、以顺序权重正交化抑制后门的免训练方法，并在多模型族、多攻击类型上与已有防御比较 ASR、KL 散度与能力变化。
evidence_note: 多模型族、多攻击类型与已评估防御的系统对比，报告 ASR、KL 与能力/安全变化；未披露统计检验，基准与攻击细节在摘要中有限。
novelty_note: 在权重正交化除后门的思路上加入拒绝子空间保护与免训练/免参考约束，解决「移除后门伤及安全行为」的已知权衡；方向估计与正交化均为已有技术的新组合。
scope: 适用于触发器可被识别的后门场景；不需要干净参考模型或投毒数据；对触发器未知、分布式后门或多触发器组合的适用性未测。
limitations: 依赖触发器已被识别这一前提；对自适应或隐蔽后门的泛化未验证；评估集中在摘要所述攻击类型，长尾攻击覆盖不明。

title: Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations: Conserving Authority across Replacement, Forking, and Rollback
abstract: Self-modifying AI agents can replace, fork, and roll back identity-bearing software while descendants remain executable. Per-successor authorization does not constrain the resulting population: siblings may duplicate quotas, combine permissions, survive ancestor cuts, or overlap predecessors during promotion. We define authorization succession, which conserves authority across the active frontier of a single-parent generation forest. Our external protocol binds each generation to a manifest, root, unique parent, complete lineage, and fresh population sequence. Separate invariants bound root-lifetime consumption and current population exposure. A staged reservation freezes predecessor residual authority during replacement, while a partitioning fork validates the complete child family. Each commit atomically fences the predecessor and activates successors. Ancestor cuts invalidate dependent descendants; rollback creates a fresh generation without restoring spent authority; and a new root requires an independent grant. Under complete mediation, authenticated records, sound effect abstraction, durable monotone state, and complete lineage accounting, we prove population-safe succession, fork conservation, revocation closure, atomic handoff, rollback non-reminting, and exclusion of self-certification. An executable evaluation covers 32 registered decisions through direct-call and mailbox mappings (64/64 replays; 28 allows, 36 denies). An independent checker accepts all 64 original traces and rejects 28/28 semantic mutants; 12/12 profile invariants, 16/16 crash cuts, and 32/32 contender schedules pass. Two external adapters reproduce all 32 decisions around measured OurArk and Darwin Godel Machine mutations, including fresh-process restart, atomic succession, and predecessor rejection. The results establish authorization succession for registered protected effects.
comment: 41 pages, 1 figure, 11 tables, and 1 algorithm; includes formal proofs and external runtime adapter evidence
title_cn: 自我修改 AI 智能体种群的授权：在替换、分叉与回滚间守恒权限
abstract_cn: 自我修改的 AI 智能体可以在后代保持可执行的同时替换、分叉与回滚承载身份的软件。按后继者的授权无法约束由此产生的种群：兄弟进程可能复制配额、合并权限、在祖先被裁撤后存活，或在晋升期间与前辈重叠。我们定义「授权继承」，在单亲代生成森林的活动前沿上守恒权限。外部协议把每个代绑定到清单、根、唯一父亲、完整谱系与新鲜种群序列；分离的不变量约束根生命周期消耗与当前种群暴露。分阶段保留在替换期间冻结前辈残余权限，分割式分叉验证完整子代家族；每次提交原子地围栏前辈并激活后继。祖先裁撤使依赖后代失效；回滚创建新代而不恢复已耗权限；新根需要独立授予。在完全中介、认证记录、健全效应抽象、持久单调状态与完整谱系记账下，我们证明种群安全继承、分叉守恒、撤销闭包、原子交接、回滚不重铸与自认证排除。可执行评估覆盖通过直调与邮箱映射的 32 个注册决策（64/64 回放；28 允许、36 拒绝）；独立检查器接受全部 64 条原始轨迹并拒绝 28/28 个语义突变体；12/12 个画像不变量、16/16 个崩溃切点与 32/32 个竞争者调度通过。两个外部适配器在测得的 OurArk 与 Darwin Godel Machine 突变周围复现全部 32 个决策，包括新进程重启、原子继承与前辈拒绝。结果为注册保护效应建立了授权继承。
summary_cn: 形式化「授权继承」：在自我修改智能体种群的替换/分叉/回滚间守恒权限并证明六类性质；32 个注册决策 64/64 回放、独立检查器拒绝 28/28 突变体，并经 OurArk 与 Darwin Godel Machine 外部适配器复现。
objective_summary: 定义自我修改智能体种群上的授权继承协议（清单、谱系、分阶段保留、原子围栏），证明种群安全、分叉守恒、撤销闭包等性质，并用可执行评估、独立检查器、突变测试与外部运行时适配器验证。
evidence_note: 64/64 回放、28/28 突变拒绝、崩溃切点与调度全覆盖，加两个外部运行时适配器复现；评估为自建注册决策集，无真实部署或统计检验。
novelty_note: 把授权从单次动作扩展到跨替换/分叉/回滚的种群动力学并给出守恒式性质与证明；该问题刻画在智能体授权方向上较新。
scope: 结论适用于注册保护效应的代际森林模型下、满足完全中介/持久单调状态等假设的系统；运行时身份与模型内部行为不在范围内。
limitations: 效应抽象的健全性是假设前提，错误抽象会传导到全部保证；评估以注册决策为主，未覆盖并发真实负载；与现有智能体框架的集成成本未报告。

title: UnifiedAttack: Evaluating the Safety of Large Multimodal Models in Synergistic Harmful Image-Text Generation
abstract: As Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) transition toward natively unified architectures, evaluating their safety in synergistic harmful image-text generation tasks becomes a critical challenge. Unlike unimodal threats, synergistic risks emerge when text and image modalities are coordinated to produce harm that significantly exceeds their individual components. We introduce UnifiedAttack, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate LMM safety in collaborative scenarios by focusing on the harmfulness gain achieved through cross-modal synergy. The benchmark incorporates samples filtered for their multimodal potential alongside a novel subset of synthesized disinformation queries. To verify identified vulnerabilities, we propose a synergistic hijacking framework featuring In-Context Reskinning (ICR) and Cognitive Planning Injection (CPI). ICR utilizes few-shot learning to wrap adversarial intent in benign virtual shells to desensitize safety filters, while CPI hijacks the reasoning path by enforcing a plan-then-execute paradigm. By compelling the system to commit to a neutral logical plan, we exploit its internal drive for consistency to induce the synchronized generation of harmful multimodal content. Extensive evaluations on state-of-the-art architectures demonstrate that UnifiedAttack consistently bypasses modern alignment. Our findings reveal that the structural helpfulness and logical coherence of unified models can be systematically weaponized, highlighting the urgent need for logic-aware defenses in synergistic generation tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/UnifiedAttack .
title_cn: UnifiedAttack：评估大型多模态模型在协同有害图文生成中的安全性
abstract_cn: 随着大型多模态模型（LMM）向原生统一架构过渡，评估其在协同有害图文生成任务中的安全性成为关键挑战。与单模态威胁不同，当文本与图像模态协同产生显著超过各自成分的危害时，协同风险便会出现。我们提出 UnifiedAttack，一个通过跨模态协同的有害性增益聚焦协同场景 LMM 安全的新基准。该基准纳入经多模态潜力过滤的样本以及新合成的虚假信息查询子集。为验证所识别的漏洞，我们提出协同劫持框架，包含上下文换装（ICR）与认知规划注入（CPI）：ICR 利用少样本学习把对抗意图包裹在良性虚拟外壳中以钝化安全过滤，CPI 通过强制「先规划后执行」范式劫持推理路径——迫使系统承诺一个中立的逻辑计划，利用其对一致性的内在驱动诱导同步生成有害多模态内容。在最先进架构上的大量评估表明，UnifiedAttack 持续绕过现代对齐。我们的发现揭示，统一模型的结构化助人性与逻辑连贯性可被系统性地武器化，凸显协同生成任务中对逻辑感知防御的迫切需求。代码见 https://github.com/bingjunluo/UnifiedAttack。
summary_cn: 提出协同有害图文生成基准 UnifiedAttack 与 ICR/CPI 劫持框架：以跨模态协同的有害性增益为指标，在多个最先进 LMM 上持续绕过对齐，暴露「先规划后执行」一致性可被武器化。
objective_summary: 构建评估统一架构多模态模型在协同有害图文生成上安全性的基准（过滤样本+合成虚假信息查询），提出 ICR 与 CPI 两种攻击机制并在多个最先进模型上测量绕过效果。
evidence_note: 多架构系统评估与自建基准（过滤+合成子集）；未报告统计检验与基线防御的定量对比，攻击有效性以成功率呈现，代码公开。
novelty_note: 把评估目标从单模态有害转向跨模态协同增益，并针对原生统一架构设计规划劫持；越狱类攻击与基准众多，协同视角属增量创新。
scope: 适用于原生统一（图文一体）架构的 LMM 安全评估；攻击依赖模型遵循规划-执行范式的一致性倾向；对非统一模型与多轮场景未覆盖。
limitations: 有害性增益的判定依赖评估标准，主观性未完全消除；合成虚假信息子集的代表性有限；未给出有效防御的实证验证。

title: Actions with Receipts: Jointly Binding Claims, Evidence, and Execution for Replayable Tool-Agent Auditing
abstract: Tool-using agents can expose citations and execution logs while leaving a critical association unaudited: whether the claim shown to a user is the claim emitted by the committed execution and supported by the cited source. A valid citation and a valid trace can therefore remain individually well formed while being transplanted across claims, actions, runs, or source versions. We introduce a claim-anchored execution contract that jointly binds the emitted claim, its exact source span, the ordered execution prefix that produced it, and the source version and access state observed by that execution. Each receipt contains an emission anchor that deterministically locates the claim inside a committed answer or claim-bearing action, together with source identifiers, offsets, hashes, quotes, and a domain-separated execution commitment. A deterministic integrity verifier reconstructs these bindings before semantic or task labels are joined. We separate this integrity plane from a pluggable support plane, so structural validity is not used as a proxy for entailment. The contract exposes seven independently testable properties: claim-emission binding, source binding, ordered-execution binding, oracle separation, persisted-object replay, execution-rerun consistency, and version/access binding. Across 1,280 cross-object attacks, the joint contract detects 1,275 substitutions (0.9961). Removing a targeted property reduces its attack-detection rate to 0.0156-0.0625. On an independently adjudicated 384-pair split, the conflict-aware support guard reaches F1 0.8865 and false acceptance 0.0729; on unseen failure families, these rates are 0.8679 and 0.0938.
comment: 35 pages, 8 figures
title_cn: 带回执的动作：联合绑定声明、证据与执行以支持可回放的工具智能体审计
abstract_cn: 使用工具的智能体可以展示引用与执行日志，却让一个关键关联处于未审计状态：呈现给用户的声明是否就是已提交执行所发出的声明、且被所引来源支持。一个有效的引用和一个有效的轨迹可以各自良构，却被跨声明、跨动作、跨运行或跨来源版本地移植。我们引入声明锚定的执行契约，把发出的声明、其精确来源区间、产生它的有序执行前缀、以及该执行观察到的来源版本与访问状态联合绑定。每份回执包含一个确定性地在已提交答案或带声明的动作内定位声明的发射锚，以及来源标识、偏移、哈希、引文与域分离的执行承诺。确定性完整性验证器在语义或任务标签加入之前重建这些绑定。我们把完整性平面与可插拔的支持平面分离，使结构有效性不被用作蕴含的代理。该契约暴露七个可独立检验的性质：声明-发射绑定、来源绑定、有序执行绑定、预言机分离、持久对象回放、执行重跑一致性与版本/访问绑定。在 1,280 次跨对象攻击中，联合契约检测出 1,275 次替换（0.9961）；移除一个针对性性质会把攻击检测率降到 0.0156–0.0625。在独立裁决的 384 对分割上，冲突感知支持守护达到 F1 0.8865、误接受 0.0729；在未见失败族上为 0.8679 与 0.0938。
summary_cn: 提出声明锚定的执行回执契约，联合绑定声明、来源区间、执行前缀与版本状态：1,280 次跨对象攻击检出 1,275 次（0.9961），移除单一性质后检测率跌至 0.0156–0.0625；独立裁决集 F1 0.8865。
objective_summary: 定义把智能体声明、引用来源与执行轨迹联合绑定的回执契约与七个可独立检验性质，配确定性完整性验证器，并在跨对象攻击、性质消融与独立裁决分割上量化检测与误接受率。
evidence_note: 1,280 次攻击、性质消融、384 对独立裁决分割与未见失败族测试；自建评测、无统计检验，但覆盖面系统。
novelty_note: 把引用核实与执行审计合成为声明级联合绑定契约并给出可独立检验的性质分解；单项组件（锚定、哈希承诺）已有，联合契约与消融设计较新。
scope: 适用于可采集有序执行前缀与来源版本的工具智能体审计；完整性结论不等于语义正确性（支持平面分离）；未覆盖执行环境本身被攻陷的情形。
limitations: 攻击模型限于跨对象替换类，未含自适应伪造回执链的对手；支持平面的裁决质量依赖所选模型；部署需要执行路径配合记录，改造成本未评估。

title: Refusal Localizes, the Damage Relocates: Safety Layers Under Few-Sample Fine-Tuning
abstract: Fine-tuning adapts aligned large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but a few dozen harmful examples can remove their refusal of harmful requests. Prior work localizes safety-related behavior to specific layers, directions, and tokens, suggesting targets for protection. We test whether successful localization and recovery support defenses that survive changes in the attack. Across six checkpoints from four model families, harmful and benign prompts remain linearly separable after attack, and patching full clean hidden states into the compromised model restores refusal at a reproducible transition depth. Building on a prior layer-freezing defense, we freeze every layer up to this depth and repeat the attack. At a hundred harmful examples, refusal remains near zero on all six checkpoints, with recovery transitions above the frozen boundary. In a second study, removing the update's top two singular directions restores refusal after short attention-only fine-tunes on four checkpoints. On Llama-3.1-8B, ordinary training changes weaken this repair and an attacker who spreads the update defeats it. A spectral detector calibrated on benign Llama fine-tunes misses most repair failures on that checkpoint. Localized freezing can nevertheless help preserve refusal when a few harmful examples enter training data unintentionally. These results show that an attacker can bypass a region identified by recovery and defeat a repair that works across multiple checkpoints, motivating five checks for defenses against adaptive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/refusal-relocates.
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 21 tables. Jungseob Lee and Dongyub Jude Lee contributed equally
title_cn: 拒绝被定位，损害被迁移：少样本微调下的安全层
abstract_cn: 微调使已对齐的大语言模型（LLM）适配下游任务，但几十个有害样本即可移除其对有害请求的拒绝。先前工作将安全相关行为定位到特定层、方向与 token，提示了保护目标。我们检验「成功的定位与恢复是否足以支撑在攻击变化下仍然有效的防御」。在四个模型族的六个检查点上，攻击后有害与良性提示仍保持线性可分，且把完整的干净隐状态补丁到受损模型可在可复现的过渡深度恢复拒绝。基于先前的层冻结防御，我们冻结至该深度的所有层并重复攻击：在一百个有害样本下，全部六个检查点的拒绝仍接近于零，恢复过渡出现在冻结边界之上。第二项研究中，移除更新的前两个奇异方向可在四个检查点上恢复注意力专属短微调后的拒绝；但在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，普通训练变化即削弱该修复，而把更新摊开的攻击者可将其击败。在良性 Llama 微调上校准的谱检测器在该检查点上漏检大多数修复失败。定位冻结仍有助于在少量有害样本无意进入训练数据时保全拒绝。这些结果表明：攻击者可绕过由恢复识别的区域，并击败在多个检查点上有效的修复；据此我们提出评估自适应微调防御的五项检查。代码见 https://github.com/js-lee-AI/refusal-relocates。
summary_cn: 在 4 族 6 个检查点上证明：少样本微调后拒绝可由隐状态补丁恢复并定位过渡深度，但层冻结防御在全量攻击下失效，奇异方向修复被普通训练变化与摊开攻击绕过，谱检测器漏检多数失败。
objective_summary: 在四个模型族六个检查点上实验检验基于定位的微调防御：测量线性可分性、恢复过渡深度、层冻结与奇异方向移除的效果，并引入自适应攻击者与谱检测器评估其边界。
evidence_note: 四族六检查点多设置受控实验、自适应攻击者评估、校准检测器漏检率量化，代码公开；结论以复现的过渡深度与全计数结果支撑。
novelty_note: 对「定位→冻结/修复」防御路线给出带负结果的系统性实证修正（损害迁移、自适应绕过），并提出五项防御检查；问题与组件均已有，修正有诊断价值。
scope: 结论适用于已对齐 LLM 在少样本（约百例级）微调攻击下的拒绝行为；覆盖四个模型族；对更大扰动预算、多模态或非拒绝型安全行为未测。
limitations: 自适应攻击评估限于摊开更新等少数策略；谱检测器校准依赖良性微调分布；五项防御检查为设计建议而非已验证方案。

title: Tokenized Key-Gated Adapter Routing: A Secure Access Control Mechanism Against Private Data Leakage in LLMs
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in privacy-critical domains (e.g., healthcare, finance, and government), but their propensity to memorize and disclose personally identifiable information (PII) poses serious security and compliance risks. Existing defenses typically force a trade-off between model utility, privacy protection, and access to fine-tuned private knowledge. We propose LoRA-Oriented Control via Keyed Entry Tokens (Locket), a practical framework that embeds fine-grained, policy-driven access control directly into LLM generation. Locket trains a set of lightweight LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapters, each encoding a distinct access policy (e.g., full reveal, partial redaction via PII masking, or reveal under a specified differential privacy level). A compact gating module is trained to associate a learned keyed entry token with exactly one LoRA adapter via sequence-level hard routing; the presence of a valid token acts as an authorization key that unlocks corresponding private knowledge, while an invalid or absent token triggers a privacy-preserving adapter that redacts or sanitizes sensitive content. This design ensures Locket remains fully compatible with off-the-shelf LLMs, supporting scalable deployment while satisfying regulatory and privacy requirements. We evaluate Locket across multiple datasets (Enron, ECHR, Yelp) and a diverse set of state-of-the-art LLMs, including Qwen3 (1.7B and 8B), Meta's Llama-3.2 (1B and 3B), and Google's Gemma-2-2B. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that, when the correct token is provided, Locket preserves perplexity comparable to fine-tuning on raw data (without any defense). Conversely, when the token is missing or invalid, it substantially reduces PII leakage while maintaining utility and perplexity on par with strong baseline defenses.
title_cn: 令牌化键控适配器路由：一种防止 LLM 私有数据泄露的安全访问控制机制
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署在隐私关键领域（如医疗、金融和政府），但其记忆并泄露个人身份信息（PII）的倾向带来严重的安全与合规风险。现有防御通常迫使模型在效用、隐私保护与对微调私有知识的访问之间权衡。我们提出 Locket（LoRA-Oriented Control via Keyed Entry Tokens），一个把细粒度、策略驱动的访问控制直接嵌入 LLM 生成的实用框架。Locket 训练一组轻量 LoRA（低秩适配）适配器，每个编码一种访问策略（如完全披露、经 PII 掩码的部分隐去、或在指定差分隐私级别下披露）。一个紧凑的门控模块通过序列级硬路由学习把已学习的键控入场令牌与恰好一个 LoRA 适配器关联；有效令牌的存在充当授权密钥，解锁相应私有知识，而无效或缺失令牌则触发隐私保护适配器，对敏感内容进行隐去或净化。该设计保证 Locket 与现成 LLM 完全兼容，支持可扩展部署并满足监管与隐私要求。我们在多个数据集（Enron、ECHR、Yelp）和多样化的最先进 LLM（包括 Qwen3（1.7B 与 8B）、Meta 的 Llama-3.2（1B 与 3B）和 Google 的 Gemma-2-2B）上评估 Locket。大量实验表明：提供正确令牌时，Locket 的困惑度与在原始数据上微调（无任何防御）相当；令牌缺失或无效时，它在保持效用与困惑度与强基线防御相当的同时，显著降低 PII 泄露。
summary_cn: 提出 Locket：用键控入场令牌经序列级硬路由选择策略化 LoRA 适配器控制 PII 披露；在 Enron/ECHR/Yelp 与五个模型上验证，有效令牌保持困惑度，无效令牌显著降低泄露且效用与强基线相当。
objective_summary: 训练策略化 LoRA 适配器与键控令牌门控模块，把访问控制嵌入 LLM 生成过程，在 Enron、ECHR、Yelp 数据集与 Qwen3/Llama-3.2/Gemma-2 等模型上测量令牌有效/缺失两种情形下的困惑度、效用与 PII 泄露。
evidence_note: 三个数据集、五个模型、与强基线防御的系统对比并报告困惑度；无统计检验，消融与泄露度量细节披露有限，评测为自建设置。
novelty_note: 把「令牌即授权」与 LoRA 硬路由组合为生成时访问控制，区别于输入过滤或输出净化；组件均已有，组合与策略化设计较新。
scope: 结论适用于可注入适配器、按令牌控制私有知识披露的部署；策略由训练时定义，运行时策略变更需重训；对抗性令牌伪造与提权攻击未评估。
limitations: 令牌的正确分发与撤销机制未讨论；门控与适配器受对抗输入影响的鲁棒性未测；差分隐私策略的实际保证未在摘要中量化验证。

title: Multi-Jurisdictional Legal Identity Assurance for Capability Gating: A Design-Science Proposal for Tiered, Reusable Identity Assurance of Natural, Juridical, and Machine Entities
abstract: Identity assurance is the cost a digital system pays for dishonesty and uncertainty: it exists to make acts attributable when not everyone can be trusted at their word. A common way to pay that cost is flat maximum verification, asking each participant to meet a single high level of identification at entry, before any capability is exercised. Paid on everyone, it over-collects, excludes participants who cannot meet a bar they never needed to clear, taxes every interaction with the cost of the rarest high-risk case, and binds the strength of identification to the activity it unlocks. Existing frameworks compound this by fixing a small number of per-credential levels inside a single legal space and binding each verification to the institution that performed it, leaving cross-border reuse and the tension between data erasure and evidentiary retention unaddressed. This paper develops, as a design-science proposal, a tiered and reusable model of identity assurance for natural, juridical, and machine entities across jurisdictions. Reading the problem through systems theory, where a system changes only when an entity acts, the model holds the assurance state apart from the capability gate that consumes it, so that identity demand follows the act and the weight of its consequences rather than mere presence: a participant may take part with minimal disclosure and supply more only as an act requires. It comprises a typed entity taxonomy, a two-axis coordinate of disclosed assertion scope and source of information, jurisdiction as a time-indexed attribute of the entity, and reliance recorded as bitemporal, liability-allocated, point-in-time snapshots. Requirements are derived from anti-money-laundering, electronic-identity, and data-protection law, and the proposal is evaluated against flat maximum verification, per-credential level-of-assurance designs, and institutional reusable-KYC reliance.
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Written to solve the AML/KYC problem in financial services: proportional customer due diligence, beneficial ownership and reusable third-party reliance under EU AMLR, AMLD4 and FATF. Covers natural persons, legal entities and machine actors from bots to AI agents; the gates extend beyond finance, e.g. to protecting minors. Published in Swissi AI Journal, CC BY 4.0
title_cn: 面向能力门控的跨辖区法律身份保证：自然人、法人与机器实体分级可复用身份保证的设计科学提案
abstract_cn: 身份保证是数字系统为「不诚实与不确定」支付的成本：它的存在是为了在并非人人可信其言时使行为可归因。支付该成本的常见方式是「平坦最大验证」——要求每个参与者在行使任何能力之前，在入口处满足单一的高识别等级。对所有人收取该成本会导致过度收集、排除无法满足本不需要达到门槛的参与者、让每次交互背上最罕见高风险案例的成本，并把识别强度与它解锁的活动绑死。现有框架还把少量按凭证划分的等级固定在单一法律空间内，并把每次验证绑定到执行验证的机构，使跨境复用、以及数据删除与证据留存之间的张力无从解决。本文以设计科学提案的形式，为跨辖区的自然人、法人与机器实体发展一个分级、可复用的身份保证模型。借助系统论（系统仅在实体行动时变化）解读问题，该模型把保证状态与消费它的能力门分离，使身份需求跟随行为及其后果的分量而非单纯在场：参与者可以最小披露参与，仅在行为要求时补充更多信息。模型包括类型化实体分类、由披露断言范围与信息来源构成的二维坐标、作为实体时间索引属性的辖区，以及以双时相、责任分配、时间点快照记录的信赖关系。需求从反洗钱、电子身份与数据保护法律推导；提案与平坦最大验证、按凭证等级设计与机构化可复用 KYC 信赖进行了对比评估。
summary_cn: 面向 AML/KYC 场景提出覆盖自然人、法人与机器实体的分级可复用身份保证模型：保证状态与能力门分离，身份需求随行为后果而定；以设计科学方法与三类现有范式对比评估，无实证部署。
objective_summary: 以设计科学方法构造跨辖区、跨实体类型（自然人/法人/机器）的分级可复用身份保证模型，将保证状态与能力门控解耦，并从反洗钱、电子身份与数据保护法律推导需求，与三类现有范式对比。
evidence_note: 设计科学提案，评估为与既有范式（平坦最大验证、按凭证等级、机构 KYC 信赖）的概念对比；无实现、无数据集、无用户或部署研究；刊于 Swissi AI Journal。
novelty_note: 组合已有身份保证与 KYC 概念（分级、可复用信赖、双时相记录）并扩展到机器实体；模型结构为已有制度的重组，未见新机制或经验发现。
scope: 面向受 EU AMLR/AMLD4 与 FATF 约束的金融服务及可外延的门控场景（如未成年人保护）；模型为提案形态，不构成可部署协议，机器实体门控仅作概念覆盖。

title: Runtime Assurance Under Measurement Attack: Necessary and Sufficient Observability Conditions for Learned Control in Radio Access Networks
abstract: Runtime assurance pairs a verified fallback with an untrusted controller and a switching monitor, and is the leading route to admitting learned policies into safety-relevant network control. Its guarantee rests on a condition it assumes rather than requires: that the monitor's estimation error is zero, or at worst stochastic with a characterisable rate. In mobile networks many measurements originate at untrusted endpoints, where the error is neither. We state this assurance precondition and prove it: at zero measurement noise the guarantee survives an adversary controlling $q$ channels if and only if the plant is $2q$-sparse observable with respect to the safety-relevant output. This is functional observability over attack supports, strictly weaker than full-state observability: on our topology a per-cell outage condition doubles the budget and one stated over total offered load triples it. The converse is a constructive attack making a safe and an unsafe trajectory observationally identical; it defeats every monitor on those channels, not one detector, at any noise level. As the trust split is static and known before deployment, confining the adversary to one family yields a confinement threshold, above which trusted channels alone resolve the state and all untrusted channels may be corrupt at once. Three uninfluenceable counters cross it here, lifting the budget from two to six and making placement the dominant lever. Below the precondition the monitor faces a frontier, not a dichotomy; a set-valued monitor is optimal and carries sufficiency into non-zero noise at the residual test's false-rejection rate. An adversary reaching the trigger radius owns the switch regardless. The same argument bounds any monitor reading agent messages rather than measurements. A rank test decides the budget and identification does not preserve it, so a published budget must name its margin floor.
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables
title_cn: 测量攻击下的运行时保障：无线接入网学习控制可观测性的充要条件
abstract_cn: 运行时保障将经过验证的回退控制器与不可信控制器及切换监控器配对，是让学习策略进入安全关键网络控制的主要途径。其保证依赖一个被假定而非被要求的条件：监控器的估计误差为零，或至多是具有可刻画速率的随机误差。在移动网络中，许多测量源自不可信端点，误差两者皆非。我们陈述并证明这一保障前提：在零测量噪声下，当对手控制 q 个信道时，保证得以幸存当且仅当被控对象关于安全相关输出是 2q-稀疏可观测的。这是「函数可观测性」在攻击支持集上的版本，严格弱于全状态可观测性：在我们的拓扑上，每小区中断条件使预算翻倍，而以总提供负载陈述的条件使其增至三倍。其逆命题是一个构造性攻击，使安全与不安全轨迹在观测上不可区分；它在这些信道上击败所有监控器，而非某个特定检测器，且在任何噪声水平下均如此。由于信任划分在部署前静态已知，把对手限制在一个族内会得到一个「围禁阈值」，高于该阈值时仅可信信道即可解析状态，而所有不可信信道可能同时被腐化。这里三个不可影响的计数器跨越该阈值，把预算从 2 提升到 6，使部署位置成为主导杠杆。低于此前提时监控器面对的是前沿而非二分：集合值监控器是最优的，并在残余检验的误拒率下把充分性带入非零噪声。到达触发半径的对手无论如何都拥有切换权。同一论证也约束任何读取智能体消息而非测量的监控器。秩检验决定预算，而辨识不保持预算，因此发布的预算必须标注其边际下限。
summary_cn: 证明测量攻击下运行时保障的充要条件（关于安全输出的 2q-稀疏可观测），给出在任意噪声下击败一切监控器的构造性攻击与围禁阈值；示例拓扑中三个不可影响计数器把预算从 2 提到 6。
objective_summary: 陈述并证明测量攻击下运行时保障前提的充要条件（关于安全输出的 2q-稀疏可观测性），构造在任意噪声水平下不可区分安全/不安全轨迹的攻击，并定义围禁阈值与集合值监控器设计。
evidence_note: 充要刻画达到紧界，配构造性攻击与具体拓扑算例（预算 2→6、条件使预算翻倍/三倍）；但结果在单一自选拓扑上陈述，无真实网络或硬件实验。
novelty_note: 首次把运行时保障隐含假设的「监控误差良性」前提形式化为可判定的充要条件，并给出对全部监控器一致的不可区分攻击与围禁阈值刻画。
scope: 结论适用于以测量为监控输入的运行时保障架构（含 RAN 学习控制），零噪声下精确、非零噪声下以集合值监控器与误拒率为界；依赖信任划分部署前已知的假设。
limitations: 证明在理想化测量模型与自选拓扑上进行，未含真实 RAN 实验；对手被限定为可控信道的族；触发半径内的对手被证明不可防御。

title: Intrusion Detection for Agentic Processes: Evidence-Based Runtime Monitoring
abstract: Agent deployments increasingly combine language-model inference with retrieval, delegation, tool execution, external-system access, and human approval. Security-relevant deviations can therefore emerge across an evolving process rather than in one isolated input or action. Building on the author's earlier black-box architecture for agentic processes and the subsequent evidence-claim model, this paper proposes an Agentic-Process Intrusion Detection System (A-IDS), an evidence-aware security interpretation layer for runtime intrusion detection whose monitored object is the agentic process itself. A-IDS compares evidence-supported observations with a governed and versioned expectation baseline for workflow state, authorization, communication, and mandatory events. Its conceptual contribution combines dynamically due governed expectations, visibility separated from three-valued matching, explicit unresolved observation states, and bounded findings that separate evidentiary status from operational impact. The model further identifies the monitoring plane itself as an attack surface when adversarial content reaches semantic evidence producers through otherwise legitimate observation paths. Some observations may be produced outside the operational agent's self-report path, but the model does not assume complete observability or universally trustworthy capture. Prompt injection is treated both as an input-security problem and as a possible origin of later process deviations and cross-agent influence paths. A-IDS does not infer malicious intent from anomalous behavior, does not treat an unobserved event as proof of non-occurrence, and does not claim a new anomaly detector, temporal logic, or provenance model. The contribution is conceptual: it does not validate an implementation, demonstrate empirical detection performance, establish causal attribution, or provide an enforcement mechanism.
comment: 7 pages, 3 tables
title_cn: 面向智能体过程的入侵检测：基于证据的运行时监控
abstract_cn: 智能体部署日益将语言模型推理与检索、委托、工具执行、外部系统访问和人工审批结合。安全相关的偏差因此可能在整个演化的过程中出现，而非集中于某个孤立的输入或动作。在作者先前的智能体过程黑盒架构与后续的证据-声明模型基础上，本文提出智能体过程入侵检测系统（A-IDS），一个用于运行时入侵检测的证据感知安全解释层，其监控对象是智能体过程本身。A-IDS 将有证据支持的观察与受治理、有版本的工作流状态预期基线（覆盖工作流状态、授权、通信与强制事件）进行比对。其概念贡献包括：动态到期的受治理预期、与三值匹配分离的可见性、显式的未决观察状态，以及区分证据状态与运营影响的有界发现。该模型进一步指出：当对抗内容经由看似合法的观察路径抵达语义证据生产者时，监控平面本身就是攻击面。部分观察可能产生自运营智能体自述路径之外，但模型不假设完全可观测或普遍可信的捕获。提示注入既被视为输入安全问题，也被视为后续过程偏差与跨智能体影响路径的可能起点。A-IDS 不从异常行为推断恶意意图，不把未观察到的事件当作未发生的证明，也不声称提出新的异常检测器、时序逻辑或溯源模型。其贡献是概念性的：不验证实现，不演示经验检测性能，不建立因果归因，也不提供执行机制。
summary_cn: 提出智能体过程入侵检测的概念模型 A-IDS：以受治理的预期基线比对该证据观察，显式处理未决状态，并指出监控平面本身可成为攻击面；作者自陈不验证实现与检测性能。
objective_summary: 定义面向智能体过程的证据感知入侵检测概念模型 A-IDS，包括动态到期的受治理预期、三值匹配、未决观察状态与有界发现，并讨论监控平面自身的攻击面。
evidence_note: 作者明确声明贡献为概念性：无实现验证、无检测性能实验、无因果归因；摘要与正文均无经验数据。
novelty_note: 在作者自身先前框架上做概念延伸；基线比对、三值匹配、证据分层等多为已有思想的重述，「监控平面即攻击面」的提法有一定启发性。
scope: 概念模型适用于把智能体过程视为监控对象的场景；不假设完全可观测与可信捕获；不适用于需要已验证检测率的部署决策。
limitations: 无任何实现或实验验证；预期基线的治理与维护成本未讨论；对自适应攻击者与多智能体串通场景未分析。

title: Evasion Attacks: How Adversarial Noise Bypasses ML Classifiers
abstract: This paper presents a reproducible, educational study of evasion attacks in image classification and text classification. A compact convolutional network trained on MNIST reached 98.63% clean test accuracy and was evaluated under two white-box attacks. Under FGSM, accuracy fell to 60.20% at $\epsilon$ = 0.15 and 1.72% at $\epsilon$ = 0.30; under PGD it fell to 32.47% and 0.41%, and a bit-depth-reduction defense recovered only part of the loss. In the second experiment, DistilBERT fine-tuned on the SMS Spam Collection reached 98.75% accuracy and a 94.96% F1-score, but a controlled sequence of pre-defined perturbations (character substitutions, whitespace noise, and a benign suffix) produced only modest probability shifts in most displayed examples and no flip from spam to ham. Adversarial vulnerability is strongly modality-dependent: the MNIST experiment is a clear evasion demonstration, whereas the text experiment is a controlled robustness evaluation. Robustness must be tested empirically rather than inferred from clean accuracy.
comment: Presented at the 58th Midwest Instruction and Computing Symposium (MICS 2026), Eau Claire, WI, March 27 to 28, 2026. 14 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables
title_cn: 规避攻击：对抗噪声如何绕过 ML 分类器
abstract_cn: 本文对图像分类与文本分类中的规避攻击做了一项可复现的教学性研究。在 MNIST 上训练的紧凑卷积网络达到 98.63% 的干净测试准确率，并在两种白盒攻击下评估：FGSM 下准确率在 ε=0.15 时降至 60.20%、ε=0.30 时降至 1.72%；PGD 下降至 32.47% 与 0.41%；位深缩减防御仅恢复部分损失。第二个实验中，在 SMS Spam Collection 上微调的 DistilBERT 达到 98.75% 准确率与 94.96% F1 分数，但受控的预定义扰动序列（字符替换、空白噪声与良性后缀）在多数展示样例中仅引起温和的概率偏移，未出现垃圾邮件到正常邮件的翻转。对抗脆弱性强烈依赖模态：MNIST 实验是清晰的规避演示，文本实验则是受控的鲁棒性评估。鲁棒性必须实证检验，而不能从干净准确率推断。
summary_cn: 教学性复现：MNIST 上 CNN 干净准确率 98.63%，FGSM ε=0.30 后仅 1.72%、PGD 后 0.41%；DistilBERT 垃圾邮件分类器对字符级扰动不翻转，显示脆弱性强烈依赖模态。
objective_summary: 在 MNIST 图像分类与 SMS 垃圾邮件文本分类两个受控实验中量化 FGSM/PGD 与字符级扰动对准确率的影响，并测试位深缩减防御的恢复程度。
evidence_note: 两个小规模受控实验，报告完整数字且可复现（会议演示）；但规模小、模型与数据集经典，结论为已知现象的再演示。
novelty_note: FGSM/PGD 与文本扰动的教学式复现，无新方法、新数据或新发现；主要价值在教育场景。
scope: 结论仅适用于文中两个小规模设置（MNIST 上的 CNN、SMS Spam 上的 DistilBERT）；不外推到其他模态、模型规模或攻击族。
limitations: 未与基线方法或已有结果系统对比；文本扰动集为人工预定义，不代表优化攻击；未探索防御改进。

title: The Cognitive Continuity Test: Verifying Governed State Transitions in Persistent AI Agents
abstract: Persistent AI agents revise beliefs, consolidate memory, and replace execution substrates. Similar successor states can accompany differently authorized transition claims, while legitimate development can change state substantially. We introduce the Cognitive Continuity Test (CCT), a policy-relative contract for verifying submitted transitions using scoped authority, provenance, deterministic application, semantic predicates, and candidate-persistence receipts. CCT distinguishes verified admissibility, affirmative violation, and unresolved required evidence. Separation results concern transition claims rather than live runtime identity; soundness is conditional on the specified checker and evaluator assumptions. IdentityLineageBench provides 24 generated transition families. The reference post-resolution verifier matches all 576 canonical held-out labels; lexical state similarity and a lineage-only diagnostic baseline admit 60.0% and 80.0% of invalid fixtures. These comparisons establish synthetic conformance, not superiority to a policy-aware deployed system. Signed adversarial regressions cover fabricated interaction counts, unsupported belief changes, and mixed missing/contradictory evidence. SIT behavior and actual model migration remain unmeasured. An 18,000-execution valid-path study measures a 6.21 ms default median on resident inputs. We specify the additional activation and recovery obligations needed for deployment.
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Includes formal proofs, transition taxonomy, and benchmark schema appendices. Reference verifier and reproducible evaluation artifacts available at this https URL
title_cn: 认知连续性测试：验证持久化 AI 智能体中受治理的状态转移
abstract_cn: 持久化 AI 智能体会修订信念、整合记忆并替换执行基底。相似的后继状态可能伴随授权依据截然不同的转移声明，而合法的开发也可能大幅改变状态。我们提出认知连续性测试（CCT），一个相对于策略的验证契约，利用范围化权限、来源、确定性应用、语义谓词与候选持久化回执来验证提交的转移。CCT 区分「已验证可接纳」「确证违规」与「未决必需证据」三种结果。分离性结果针对转移声明而非运行时活体身份；可靠性以指定的检查器与评估器假设为条件。IdentityLineageBench 提供 24 个生成的转移族；参考后置解析验证器匹配全部 576 个规范留出标签，而词面状态相似度与仅谱系诊断基线分别接纳 60.0% 与 80.0% 的无效样本。这些对比确立的是合成符合性，而非对策略感知的部署系统的优越性。签名对抗回归覆盖伪造交互计数、无依据信念变更与缺失/矛盾证据混合等情况。SIT 行为与真实模型迁移仍未测量。一项 18,000 次执行的有效路径研究测得驻留输入上的默认中位时延 6.21 毫秒。我们给出了部署所需的额外激活与恢复义务的规格。
summary_cn: 提出验证持久智能体状态转移的 CCT 契约与 24 族基准：参考验证器 576/576 匹配留出标签，词面与谱系基线分别漏纳 60%/80% 无效转移，18,000 次执行中位时延 6.21 ms。
objective_summary: 定义针对持久智能体状态转移的策略相对验证契约 CCT（范围化权限、来源、确定性应用、持久化回执），配套 24 个转移族的 IdentityLineageBench 基线对比与性能测量。
evidence_note: 576 个留出标签的参考符合性 + 两个基线漏纳率 + 18,000 次执行的时延测量，工件公开；但数据自建合成，作者自陈确立的是合成符合性而非对真实部署系统的优越性。
novelty_note: 把智能体安全从「单次动作授权」推进到「状态转移的治理验证」，提出可验证的连续性契约与三态裁决（可接纳/违规/证据未决），问题刻画较新。
scope: 结论适用于以提交式转移为模型的持久化智能体；分离性结果针对转移声明而非运行时身份，可靠性依赖指定检查器与评估器假设；真实模型迁移未测。
limitations: 基准为合成生成的转移族，与真实部署的差距未量化；SIT 行为与实际模型迁移未测量；部署仍需额外的激活与恢复机制（文中仅为规格）。

title: A Verifier Can Leak the Answer: Diagnosability Before Optimization in Closed-Loop Agent Debugging
abstract: Agent developers increasingly compare prompts, tools, policies, and diagnosis algorithms through simulator-grounded verifiers. A verifier can nevertheless make a solver comparison vacuous: if its probes or predicates encode the target identity, an exact optimizer may appear effective without resolving any genuine ambiguity. We report such a failure in an aggregate-trace debugger for a closed-loop decision agent. Exact minimum hitting set (MHS) and a propagation-aware greedy method returned identical supports in 12/12 development cases and the same planted-fault recovery in 9/12. A subsequent audit found that exact-anchor predicates produced the planted pair in 9/9 cases. After removing those anchors, overall planted-pair recovery was 8/9; hard-probe singleton pairs nevertheless matched the planted pair in 9/9, and no case retained a nonempty residual conflict family after propagation (0/9). The optimizer was correct, but the verifier had already disclosed the answer. We replace solver-first evaluation with a support-gated verification contract. A clean reference map must first show repeated component exposure; a matched reference/current gate must then establish comparable runtime evidence; only afterward may an independently calibrated signal rule return a detection. In a preregistered heldout comprising 1,440 cases and 21,600 partition rows, 55/72 regime-component units passed the reference gate, 54/55 passed the runtime gate, and stable false admission was 0/20 represented components with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391. Within admitted units, affected clean traffic predicted detection better than nominal fault-cell fraction. The main lesson is structural: verify evidence eligibility and non-revelation before optimizing the component selector. Otherwise a stronger solver can merely certify a stronger verifier artifact.

title_cn: 验证器会泄露答案：闭环智能体调试中的可诊断性先于优化
abstract_cn: 智能体开发者越来越多地通过基于模拟器的验证器来比较提示词、工具、策略与诊断算法。然而，如果验证器的探测或谓词编码了目标身份，求解器比较就可能失去意义：一个精确优化器可能显得有效，而实际并未消解任何真正的歧义。我们在一个闭环决策智能体的聚合轨迹调试器中报告了这样一次失败：精确最小命中集（MHS）与传播感知贪心方法在 12/12 个开发案例中返回了完全相同的支持集，并在 9/12 个案例中给出相同的植入故障恢复。随后的审计发现，精确锚点谓词在 9/9 个案例中直接产生了植入对。移除这些锚点后，整体植入对恢复为 8/9；但硬探测单例对仍在 9/9 个案例中与植入对匹配，且传播后没有任何案例保留非空残余冲突族（0/9）。优化器是正确的，但验证器早已泄露了答案。我们以支持门控验证契约取代求解器优先的评估：干净的参考图必须先显示重复的组件暴露；匹配的参考/当前门控随后必须建立可比的运行时证据；此后才允许独立校准的信号规则返回检测。在包含 1,440 个案例与 21,600 行分区数据的预注册留出集上，55/72 个状态-组件单元通过参考门控，54/55 通过运行时门控，稳定误接纳为 0/20 个被表征组件，单侧精确 95% 置信上界为 0.1391。在被接纳单元内，受影响的干净流量比标称故障单元比例更能预测检测。主要教训是结构性的：在优化组件选择器之前，先验证证据资格与不可泄露性；否则更强的求解器只会认证一个更强的验证器伪影。
summary_cn: 诊断出闭环智能体调试中验证器谓词泄露植入答案的问题（锚点谓词 9/9 复现植入对），提出支持门控验证契约；预注册留出集 1,440 案例上误接纳 0/20，95% 上界 0.1391。
objective_summary: 报告并审计聚合轨迹调试器中验证器泄露答案的失败案例，提出先验证证据资格与不可泄露性、再优化选择器的支持门控验证契约，并在预注册留出集上量化门控的误接纳率。
evidence_note: 预注册留出集（1,440 案例、21,600 行）+ 单侧精确 95% 置信界 + 复现工件公开；12/12、9/9 等全计数结果，统计口径明确。
novelty_note: 把评测有效性中的「验证器泄露」问题带进智能体调试场景并给出可执行的验证契约；泄露与预注册评测本身均非新概念，组合有诊断价值。
scope: 结论来自单一闭环决策智能体的聚合轨迹调试测试床与预注册留出集；对其他智能体形态、其他验证器族群的适用性未测。
limitations: 开发期案例仅 12 例、留出分析在个位数案例上进行，外推有限；契约的门控阈值依赖独立校准信号的质量；未评估适应性攻击者对门控本身的规避。

title: A Comprehensive Review of One-Pixel Attack: Research Status, Taxonomy, Applications, Regulation Policy and Future Directions
abstract: One-Pixel Attacks (OPAs) represent one of the most extreme demonstrations of adversarial fragility in deep learning, where modifying a single pixel can reliably induce high-confidence misclassification across domains such as medical diagnosis, autonomous driving, biometrics, and quantum communication. Despite their conceptual simplicity, OPAs remain underexamined in existing adversarial-attack surveys, which provide only fragmented or cursory coverage. This PRISMA-guided review synthesizes high-quality studies from 2017 to 2026 and delivers a unified, multi-axis taxonomy of OPA research spanning algorithmic foundations, black-box evolutionary optimization, emerging hybrid and program-synthesis attacks, defence mechanisms, interpretability tools, and domain-specific vulnerabilities. Our analysis reveals the dominance of Differential Evolution-based strategies, the rise of efficiency-optimized and saliency-guided methods, and persistent gaps in dataset diversity, transferability, and standardized evaluation. We summarized and assess defence paradigms including pixel restoration, anomaly detection, input-space transformations, and robust training highlighting their trade-offs in robustness, imperceptibility, and computational overhead. Building on these insights, we outline future research priorities involving selective pixel recovery, transformer-specific vulnerability analysis, saliency-driven optimization, and real-world domain-adaptive defences. We further propose a regulatory framework emphasizing robustness testing, incident disclosure, and AI security governance. This review establishes a comprehensive foundation for understanding, evaluating, and mitigating ultra-sparse adversarial threats in contemporary AI systems.
title_cn: 单像素攻击综合评述：研究现状、分类、应用、监管政策与未来方向
abstract_cn: 单像素攻击（OPA）是深度学习对抗脆弱性最极端的表现之一：仅修改一个像素即可在医学诊断、自动驾驶、生物识别和量子通信等领域可靠地诱发高置信度误分类。尽管概念简单，OPA 在现有对抗攻击综述中仍缺乏充分覆盖，仅有零散或粗略的论述。本评述遵循 PRISMA 规范，综合 2017 至 2026 年的高质量研究，给出覆盖算法基础、黑盒进化优化、新兴混合与程序合成攻击、防御机制、可解释性工具与领域特定脆弱性的统一多轴分类。分析显示：基于差分进化的策略占主导，效率优化与显著性引导的方法兴起，数据集多样性、可迁移性与标准化评测仍存在持续缺口。我们总结并评估了像素恢复、异常检测、输入空间变换与鲁棒训练等防御范式，凸显其在鲁棒性、不可感知性与计算开销上的权衡。据此我们提出未来研究优先级：选择性像素恢复、Transformer 特定脆弱性分析、显著性驱动优化与面向真实领域的自适应防御，并进一步提出强调鲁棒性测试、事件披露与 AI 安全治理的监管框架。
summary_cn: PRISMA 规范下综合 2017–2026 年单像素攻击研究：差分进化策略占主导，防御以像素恢复/异常检测/输入变换/鲁棒训练为主，指出数据多样性、可迁移性与标准评测缺口并提出监管框架。
objective_summary: 以 PRISMA 流程系统综述 2017–2026 年单像素攻击研究，建立多轴分类，评估防御范式权衡并给出研究优先级与监管建议。
evidence_note: PRISMA 系统检索与综合，但本身无新实验；对方法趋势（差分进化主导等）的判断来自文献归纳。
novelty_note: 现有对抗攻击综述对 OPA 覆盖零散，本综述给出该细分方向首个统一多轴分类并延伸到监管层面；所覆盖的基础方法均为已有工作。
scope: 覆盖 2017–2026 年发表的单像素攻击与防御文献；结论适用于极低扰动预算（单像素）场景，不涵盖一般对抗鲁棒性。
limitations: OPA 研究本身规模有限，跨领域可比性弱；防御评估口径不一导致横向对比受限；监管框架部分属立场性建议。

title: Characterizing and Codifying Malware Sophistication
abstract: 'Sophisticated' is widely used to describe malware, yet it lacks a consistent definition within academic literature. While existing software quality and complexity metrics offer some insight into malware structure, they do not capture the broader adversarial and operational traits that contribute to real-world threat potential. This paper presents a systematization of existing approaches for assessing malware quality using static binary analysis. We define malware sophistication through a quality-focused lens by reinterpreting select characteristics from the ISO/IEC 25010 software quality standard, including reliability, maintainability, flexibility, and security, and evaluating their applicability to malware binaries. We identify which characteristics are both relevant to malware and measurable through static analysis, forming the basis for future frameworks that consistently assess malware sophistication when source code is unavailable or dynamic execution is infeasible.

title_cn: 刻画并规范化恶意软件复杂度
abstract_cn: 「复杂/精密」（sophisticated）被广泛用于描述恶意软件，但学术文献中缺乏一致定义。现有软件质量与复杂度度量虽能部分反映恶意软件结构，却无法捕捉构成现实威胁潜力的更广泛的对抗性与运作性特征。本文对使用静态二进制分析评估恶意软件质量的已有方法做了系统化整理。我们以质量视角重新诠释 ISO/IEC 25010 软件质量标准中的若干特征——包括可靠性、可维护性、灵活性与安全性——并评估其对恶意软件二进制的适用性，以此定义恶意软件复杂度。我们识别出哪些特征既与恶意软件相关又可通过静态分析度量，为在源代码不可得或动态执行不可行时一致评估恶意软件复杂度的未来框架奠定基础。
summary_cn: 以 ISO/IEC 25010 质量标准为镜，系统化静态二进制层面可度量且与恶意软件相关的复杂度特征，为无源码场景下评估恶意软件复杂度奠定框架基础。
objective_summary: 系统整理静态二进制分析下恶意软件质量评估方法，从 ISO/IEC 25010 挑选既相关又可度量的特征作为复杂度定义基础。
evidence_note: 系统化梳理但未做新的实证：未在样本上验证所选特征与真实复杂度或威胁的关联；发表于区域会议 IETC 2026（7 页）。
novelty_note: 把成熟软件质量标准搬到恶意软件场景，属对已有度量的重新组合；无新机制、新数据或新实验发现。
scope: 结论适用于仅有二进制、无源码且不可动态执行的场景；所选特征的度量可行性未在真实恶意软件语料上验证。
limitations: 未提供可运行的评估框架或实验验证；特征与实际威胁潜力的关联仍属假设；篇幅 7 页，覆盖深度有限。

title: Safety in Self-Evolving Agents: A Survey
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities, yet their parameters typically remain fixed after deployment, limiting learning from new interactions. In open-ended environments, this motivates self-evolving agents that continually update reusable state-including model parameters, memories, tool definitions, skills, and workflows-from data, feedback, and accumulated experience. This shift changes the safety problem: once experience becomes reusable state, past events become future causes, and information harmless in one context may later influence decisions with greater persistence, authority, or scope. Self-evolving agent safety therefore asks not only whether a response is aligned or an action authorized, but whether safety properties survive the accumulation, generalization, and cross-context reuse of locally useful experience. We introduce SAVER, a transition-centered framework in which Substrate locates reusable influence, Adaptation captures how it changes, Violation identifies compromised safety attributes, Exposure marks where failures become observable, and Response assesses containment, repair, or revocation. Our survey reveals that failures need not originate from harmful information: legitimate state can become unsafe when adaptation expands its persistence, authority, or scope beyond the conditions under which it was valid. Existing work provides comparatively strong evidence for admission, retrieval, activation, exposure, and local containment, but much less for descendant repair and evaluation after adaptation resumes. We therefore argue for longitudinal evaluation that traces unsafe influence to its originating transition, verifies repair across descendants, and tests whether it can re-emerge under continued evolution.

title_cn: 自进化智能体的安全：综述
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的通用能力，但其参数通常在部署后即固定，限制了从新交互中学习。在开放环境中，这催生了自进化智能体——从数据、反馈和积累的经验中持续更新可复用状态，包括模型参数、记忆、工具定义、技能与工作流。这一转变改变了安全问题的性质：一旦经验成为可复用状态，过去的事件就成为未来的原因，在某一语境中无害的信息日后可能以更大的持久性、权限或作用范围影响决策。因此，自进化智能体的安全不仅要问某个响应是否对齐、某个动作是否被授权，还要问安全性质能否在局部有用经验的积累、泛化与跨语境复用中幸存。我们提出 SAVER，一个以状态转移为中心的框架：Substrate 定位可复用的影响，Adaptation 刻画其如何变化，Violation 识别被损害的安全属性，Exposure 标记故障在何处变得可观察，Response 评估遏制、修复或撤销。本综述揭示，故障无需源自有害信息：合法状态在适应将其持久性、权限或作用范围扩展到原本有效条件之外时也可能变得不安全。现有工作对准入、检索、激活、暴露与局部遏制提供了相对较强的证据，但对适应恢复后的后代修复与评估的证据则少得多。因此我们主张纵向评估：追踪不安全影响直至其起源转移，在后代上验证修复，并检验其在持续进化下能否重新出现。
summary_cn: 提出以状态转移为中心的 SAVER 框架综述自进化智能体安全：合法经验经积累与跨语境复用可变为不安全，现有证据集中在准入/检索/激活/暴露与局部遏制，后代修复与纵向评估缺失。
objective_summary: 系统综述自进化智能体的安全问题，提出 SAVER 转移框架（Substrate/Adaptation/Violation/Exposure/Response），梳理各环节现有证据强度并给出纵向评估研究议程。
evidence_note: 纯文献综合（80 页、13 表、6 图），未做新的实验；对各阶段证据强弱的论断基于其对已有工作的归纳。
novelty_note: 把自进化智能体安全确立为独立问题域，提出以状态转移而非单次响应为中心的新框架与纵向评估主张；该问题域较新，此前缺乏专门系统化。
scope: 结论适用于参数、记忆、工具、技能等状态可持续更新的智能体；对具体架构与部署规模未限定，SAVER 框架本身未经实现验证。
limitations: 综述性工作，未提供新的实证；SAVER 框架的可操作性未经实现检验；对现有证据强弱的评级依赖作者的主观归纳。

title: On The Simplest Quantum-Secure Block Cipher
abstract: Pseudorandom permutations are ubiquitous in theoretical and applied cryptography. PRPs that offer security even against adversaries making quantum queries are of increasing interest, and used in applications ranging from constructing pseudorandom unitaries to separating SZK from BQP. A successful framework for constructing classically-secure PRPs is the key-alternating Even-Mansour approach, which interleaves applications of public permutations with additions of round keys. The single-round construction is already classically secure in the ideal permutation model (IPM), with added rounds offering improved concrete security. However, in the quantum-query setting, the status of this framework is presently unclear. A simple quantum-query attack based on Simon's algorithm breaks the one-round cipher. For two or more rounds, security is only known against non-adaptive adversaries who must prepare all queries in advance. In this work, we show that the two-round Even-Mansour cipher is information theoretically secure in the IPM against adversaries making polynomially-many adaptive forward and inverse quantum queries to all available oracles. Our proof uses compressed permutation oracles and a specially crafted isometry relating the ideal and real experiments. We also show that this construction is minimal, in the sense that essentially any cipher constructed via a single call to a public permutation is quantumly insecure.
title_cn: 关于最简单的量子安全分组密码
abstract_cn: 伪随机置换（PRP）在理论密码学与应用密码学中无处不在。即便对于发起量子查询的攻击者也能提供安全保证的 PRP 正受到越来越多的关注，其应用涵盖构造伪随机酉算子到将 SZK 与 BQP 分离等多个方向。构造经典安全 PRP 的一个成功框架是密钥交替 Even-Mansour 方法，该方法将公开置换的应用与轮密钥的加法交替组合。单轮构造在理想置换模型（IPM）下已具备经典安全性，增加轮数则能提供更强的具体安全性。然而，在量子查询场景下，该框架的安全状态目前尚不明朗。一种基于 Simon 算法的简单量子查询攻击可以攻破单轮密码。对于两轮及以上，安全性仅在非自适应攻击者（必须提前准备所有查询）的情形下得到证明。在本工作中，我们证明了两轮 Even-Mansour 密码在 IPM 下对所有可用预言机发起多项式次自适应前向与逆向量子查询的攻击者具有信息论安全性。我们的证明使用了压缩置换预言机，以及一个精心构造的联系理想实验与真实实验的等距同构。我们还证明了该构造是最简的，即：实质上任何通过对公开置换的单次调用所构造的密码在量子意义下都是不安全的。
summary_cn: 证明理想置换模型下两轮 Even-Mansour 分组密码对多项式次自适应正反向量子查询信息论安全，并说明单次调用公开置换的构造在量子查询下不安全。
objective_summary: 在理想置换模型下证明两轮 Even-Mansour 对自适应正反向量子查询信息论安全，工具是压缩置换预言机与定制等距；并证明仅一次调用公开置换的分组密码在量子设定下几乎必然不安全。
evidence_note: 纯理论安全性证明；摘要给出两条结果（两轮安全与单次调用不可行），未附数值实验。
novelty_note: 将此前仅对非自适应敌手已知的两轮安全推广到自适应正反向量子查询，并给出极简性论证。
scope: 理想置换模型下成立；针对两轮 Even-Mansour 构造与仅一次调用公开置换的分组密码类。
limitations: 结果在理想置换模型下成立；摘要未讨论标准模型或具体置换实例化下的安全保证。

title: Exponential quantum speedup for $\mathbb{F}_3^n$-Subset-Sum? Or, rigorous classical algorithms for Binary-Error LWE
abstract: We study vector subset sum over $\mathbb{F}_3^n$: given $m$ random vectors from $\mathbb{F}_3^n$, find a nonempty subset that sums to zero; the smaller $m$, the more difficult it is to find such a subset. Chen, Liu, and Zhandry (EUROCRYPT'22) introduced an efficient quantum algorithm that solves this problem when $m\approx n^2/2$, where a naive classical algorithm would require exponential time. Subsequently, Kothari, O'Donnell, and Wu (STOC'2026) gave an efficient classical algorithm that only requires $m \approx n^2/3$ vectors, thus removing the hope for an exponential quantum advantage in this parameter regime. Using the framework of Chen, Liu, and Zhandry, we give quantum algorithms that require much fewer input vectors, renewing the possibility of an exponential quantum speedup: for any fixed $\epsilon>0$, our quantum algorithm solves $\mathbb{F}_3$-subset sum in polynomial time with $m=\epsilon\cdot n^2$ vectors. More generally, we establish a full sample--time tradeoff that interpolates between exponential and polynomial runtime. The main ingredient is a deterministic classical algorithm for the binary-error Learning-with-Errors problem, which is of independent cryptographic interest. For this, we rigorously establish a sample--time tradeoff that was predicted by earlier algebraic heuristics. For vector subset sums over larger fields, we also significantly improve classical algorithms in Kothari, O'Donnell, and Wu (STOC'2026).
title_cn: F_3^n 上子集和的指数级量子加速？或，二元误差 LWE 的严格经典算法
abstract_cn: 我们研究 F_3^n 上的向量子集和问题：给定来自 F_3^n 的 m 个随机向量，找到一个非空子集使其和为零；m 越小，找到这样的子集就越困难。Chen、Liu 和 Zhandry（EUROCRYPT'22）提出了一种高效量子算法，能在 m ≈ n^2/2 时求解该问题，而此时朴素经典算法需要指数级时间。此后，Kothari、O'Donnell 和 Wu（STOC'2026）给出了一种高效经典算法，仅需 m ≈ n^2/3 个向量，从而消除了在这一参数区间内获得指数级量子优势的希望。利用 Chen、Liu 和 Zhandry 的框架，我们给出了所需输入向量更少的量子算法，重新带来了指数级量子加速的可能：对任意固定的 ε>0，我们的量子算法以多项式时间用 m=ε·n^2 个向量求解 F_3 上的子集和问题。更一般地，我们建立了一个完整的样本-时间权衡，在指数级与多项式级运行时之间进行插值。核心工具是针对二元误差带错误学习（Learning-with-Errors，LWE）问题的确定性经典算法，该算法本身具有独立的密码学价值。为此，我们严格建立了一种此前由代数启发式方法所预测的样本-时间权衡。对于更大域上的向量子集和问题，我们也显著改进了 Kothari、O'Donnell 和 Wu（STOC'2026）中的经典算法。
summary_cn: 在 F3^n 向量子集和问题上给出所需向量仅为 εn² 的多项式时间量子算法，建立样本-时间折中；主要工具是二元误差 LWE 的确定性经典算法。
objective_summary: 在 Chen-Liu-Zhandry 框架下，构造任意 ε>0、m=εn² 向量下 F3 子集和的多项式时间量子算法，并给出二元误差 LWE 的确定性经典算法与完整的样本-时间折中。
evidence_note: 纯理论算法分析与折中证明；摘要给出参数范围与一个连续折中，未附数值实验。
novelty_note: 在 Kothari 等的 n²/3 经典界之下重开指数量子加速的可能性，并严格建立此前仅由代数启发式预测的折中。
scope: 针对 F3^n 向量子集和与二元误差 LWE；大场情形下亦改进了已有经典算法。
limitations: 量子-经典差距只在特定参数区间展示；摘要未定量比较固定 ε 下两者的实际常数。

title: Need for Coherent Access in Constructing Quantum Cryptography
abstract: We construct quantum oracles relative to which quantum-secure one-way functions (OWFs) exist but pseudorandom states (PRSs) with superlogarithmic output length do not. At first glance, this appears to contradict the known black-box constructions of PRS generators from quantum-secure OWFs. The distinction lies in the access model to the oracles; our oracle separation uses \emph{classical-accessible} random oracles that can be accessed only classically even by quantum algorithms. In fact, our impossibility of PRSs applies to \emph{any} classically accessible classical oracle in place of the random oracle, while keeping the other oracle component unchanged, showing the need for coherent access in constructing PRSs. We further show that logarithmic output length pseudorandom function-like states (PRFSs) exist relative to our oracles, giving an oracle separation between classically accessible logarithmic length PRFSs and superlogarithmic length PRSs. This shows that fully black-box PRS length extension from logarithmic to superlogarithmic output length must use coherent access to the underlying short PRS.
title_cn: 构造量子密码学对相干访问的必要性
abstract_cn: 我们构造量子预言机，相对于该预言机，量子安全单向函数（OWF）存在，但超对数输出长度的伪随机态（PRS）不存在。乍看之下，这似乎与已知的从量子安全 OWF 黑盒构造 PRS 生成器的方法相矛盾。区别在于访问预言机的模型；我们的预言机分离使用了经典可访问随机预言机——即便量子算法也只能以经典方式访问它。事实上，我们关于 PRS 不可能性的结论适用于以任意经典可访问经典预言机替换随机预言机（保持其他预言机组件不变）的情形，从而表明构造 PRS 需要相干访问。我们进一步证明，相对于我们的预言机，对数输出长度的伪随机函数类态（PRFS）存在，从而给出了经典可访问对数长度 PRFS 与超对数长度 PRS 之间的预言机分离。这表明从对数到超对数输出长度的完全黑盒 PRS 长度扩展必须对底层短 PRS 使用相干访问。
summary_cn: 构造一组量子预言机，使得量子安全单向函数存在但超对数长度伪随机态不存在，说明从 OWF 构造 PRS 需要相干访问。
objective_summary: 给出 OWF 存在而超对数输出长度 PRS 不存在的量子预言机分离，并进一步分离经典可访问的对数长度 PRFS 与超对数长度 PRS。
evidence_note: 纯理论黑盒预言机分离；摘要给出两条分离结果与适用范围，未附实验。
novelty_note: 指出相干访问在 PRS 构造与长度扩展中的必要性，给出此前未报的分离结果。
scope: 量子预言机模型；对任意可经典访问的经典预言机替换随机预言机均适用，保持另一预言机不变。
limitations: 结果为黑盒分离；摘要未讨论对具体 PRS 构造的非黑盒绕过。

title: Verifiable Quantum Advantage and Computation via Quantum Circuit Obfuscation
abstract: We construct protocols for classically verifiable quantum advantage and classical verification of $\mathsf{BQP}$ computations using \emph{quantum indistinguishability obfuscation} (qiO). Specifically, given qiO and assuming a slightly stronger version of $\mathsf{BQP}\neq\mathsf{BPP}$, we construct a two-message quantum-advantage protocol that is efficiently and publicly verifiable. Our result can be viewed as a rigorous cryptographic foundation for the heuristic quantum advantage proposals based on \emph{peaked random circuit sampling} of Aaronson and Zhang (arXiv:2404.14493). We also construct two simple protocols for classically verifying arbitrary $\mathsf{BQP}$ computations. The first protocol is privately verifiable and assumes only the existence of qiO. This gives a rare example of a nontrivial cryptographic application of (quantum) iO that does not make additional computational hardness assumptions. The second protocol additionally assumes post-quantum one-way functions and is \emph{publicly verifiable}. To our knowledge, this is the first publicly verifiable protocol for classical verification of $\mathsf{BQP}$ computations under computational assumptions in the standard model. We show that all our results hold when qiO is assumed only for ancilla-free unitary circuits. As evidence supporting this assumption, we prove a worst-to-average-case reduction for obfuscating such circuits. This reduction extends the local-mixing framework of Canetti, Chamon, Mucciolo and Ruckenstein (TCC 2024) under quantum analogues of their assumptions.
title_cn: 基于量子电路混淆的可验证量子优势与计算验证
abstract_cn: 我们使用量子不可区分混淆（qiO）构造了经典可验证量子优势协议以及 BQP 计算的经典验证协议。具体而言，在给定 qiO 并假设 BQP ≠ BPP 的略强版本成立的条件下，我们构造了一个可高效公开验证的两消息量子优势协议。我们的结果可视为 Aaronson 与 Zhang（arXiv:2404.14493）基于峰值随机电路采样的启发式量子优势方案的严格密码学基础。我们还构造了两个用于经典验证任意 BQP 计算的简单协议。第一个协议是私密可验证的，仅假设 qiO 的存在；这给出了（量子）iO 的非平凡密码学应用的一个罕见例子，且不需要额外的计算困难性假设。第二个协议额外假设后量子单向函数的存在，且是公开可验证的；据我们所知，这是在标准模型下基于计算假设对 BQP 计算进行经典验证的首个公开可验证协议。我们证明，当 qiO 仅对无辅助位酉电路成立时，我们所有的结果仍然成立。作为支持这一假设的证据，我们证明了对此类电路进行混淆的最坏情况到平均情况归约，该归约在其假设的量子类比下扩展了 Canetti、Chamon、Mucciolo 与 Ruckenstein（TCC 2024）的局部混合框架。
summary_cn: 基于量子不可区分混淆（qiO），构造两消息、可高效公开验证的量子优势协议，以及两个经典验证 BQP 计算的协议（仅需 qiO 的私密可验证方案，和另需后量子单向函数的公开可验证方案）；作者称后者是标准模型下基于计算假设的首个公开可验证 BQP 经典验证协议。
objective_summary: 在 qiO 与后量子单向函数等假设下，给出公开可验证的量子优势协议与经典验证 BQP 的两类协议；并证明无辅助比特酉电路混淆的最坏到平均归约。
evidence_note: 纯理论构造与安全性归约证明；摘要以假设与归约形式呈现，未报告数值或实验。
novelty_note: 作者自称为标准模型下首个公开可验证的 BQP 经典验证协议，并为峰值随机电路采样提供密码学基础。
scope: 依赖 qiO 存在、BQP≠BPP 的加强版与后量子单向函数等假设；混淆只需对无辅助比特酉电路成立。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；结论均以 qiO 存在为前提，量子优势协议另需略强的 BQP≠BPP，公开可验证协议另需后量子单向函数。

title: Query-Limited RAM Programs and their Applications
abstract: Quantum one-time programs (Broadbent, Gutoski and Stebila, CRYPTO 2013) or OTPs for short, enable a functionality to be encoded into a quantum token that can be evaluated on a single chosen input and then becomes unusable. While powerful, this primitive is inherently stateless and tied to a setting in which a quantum token needs to be issued and distributed for every single evaluation of a circuit. This raises a natural question: can the one-time computation paradigm be extended to richer, stateful forms of controlled access, and would such an extension offer inherent advantages beyond standard OTPs? We introduce $\textit{query-limited RAM programs}$ (QLPs), a RAM-generalization of QOTPs that supports structured, stateful computation under bounded or policy-driven access. QLPs allow controlled sequences of evaluations while preventing adversarial forking or rollback of computational state. This enables new applications beyond stateless one-time programs, including quantum tokens for Turing Machines whose size depends only on $\textit{code length}$ (and not runtime), transferable $k$-time or budget-limited programs, and low-communication mechanisms for delegating computation in settings such as Software-as-a-Service. To construct QLPs, we introduce $\textit{one-shot programs}$, unifying one-shot signatures (Amos, Georgiou, Kiayias and Zhandry, STOC 2020) with the single effective query paradigm (Gupte, Liu, Raizes, Roberts and Vaikuntanathan, STOC 2025). We prove that one-shot programs generically imply query-limited programs, demonstrating that the strengthened unclonability guarantees of one-shot signatures translate into enhanced functionality. Along the way, we clarify the relationship between signature-token primitives and quantum one-time programs via generic constructions, essentially showing that one-time signing programs imply one-time general computation.
title_cn: 查询受限 RAM 程序及其应用
abstract_cn: 量子一次性程序（Broadbent、Gutoski 与 Stebila，CRYPTO 2013，简称 OTP）能够将某个功能编码进量子令牌，该令牌可对单一选定输入求值，此后即失效。尽管功能强大，这一原语本质上是无状态的，且局限于每次电路求值都需要发行并分发量子令牌的场景。这引出一个自然的问题：一次性计算范式能否扩展到更丰富的、有状态的受控访问形式？这样的扩展是否能提供超越标准 OTP 的固有优势？我们引入查询受限 RAM 程序（QLPs），这是 QOTP 的 RAM 推广，支持在有界或策略驱动的访问下进行结构化的有状态计算。QLPs 允许受控的求值序列，同时防止对手对计算状态进行分叉或回滚。这使得超越无状态一次性程序的新应用成为可能，包括：大小仅取决于代码长度（而非运行时间）的图灵机量子令牌、可转移的 k 次或预算受限程序，以及在软件即服务（Software-as-a-Service）等场景中委托计算的低通信开销机制。为构造 QLPs，我们引入 one-shot 程序（one-shot programs），将 one-shot 签名（Amos、Georgiou、Kiayias 与 Zhandry，STOC 2020）与单次有效查询范式（Gupte、Liu、Raizes、Roberts 与 Vaikuntanathan，STOC 2025）统一起来。我们证明 one-shot 程序可通用地蕴含查询受限程序，表明 one-shot 签名增强的不可克隆性保证可转化为更强的功能。在此过程中，我们通过一般性构造阐明了签名令牌原语与量子一次性程序之间的关系，从本质上表明一次性签名程序蕴含一次性通用计算。
summary_cn: 提出查询受限 RAM 程序（QLP），将量子一次性程序推广到有状态、受控访问的计算；为构造 QLP 引入统一 one-shot 签名与单次有效查询范式的 one-shot 程序，证明其可通用地蕴含 QLP，并说明一次性签名程序蕴含一次性通用计算。
objective_summary: 定义查询受限 RAM 程序这一原语，引入由 one-shot 签名与单次有效查询范式统一而来的 one-shot 程序，并证明其可通用地构造出 QLP；摘要列出图灵机量子令牌、可转移 k 次或预算受限程序、SaaS 低通信委托等应用。
evidence_note: 纯理论构造与通用归约证明；摘要未给出具体定理数、参数或实例化效率分析。
novelty_note: 提出 QLP 原语，把一次性程序推广到有状态设定，并以 one-shot 程序统一 one-shot 签名与单次有效查询范式。
scope: 量子密码设定；构造依赖 one-shot 程序与 one-shot 签名等原语，应用涵盖图灵机令牌、k 次程序与 SaaS 委托计算。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；为纯理论构造，未给出具体效率或参数边界。

title: A Fourier-Label Information-Loss Barrier for Dihedral Coset Algorithms
abstract: We establish a no-go theorem for a broad class of quantum algorithms for the dihedral coset problem (DCP). We consider the Fourier-sampling and subset-sum-measurement template proposed by Regev (SIAM Journal on Computing, 2004), which is one of the main approaches to solving DCP. Suppose that, after measuring the lower $n-1$ bits of the subset sum, the algorithm discards any $\omega(\log n)$ bits from each of the Fourier labels. Then we prove that the algorithm cannot succeed in solving DCP. This shows that any algorithm following this template must make extensive use of the Fourier labels, and thus serves as a useful guide for developing algorithms for DCP. As a main application, we show that the recent algorithm by Simon (IACR ePrint:2026/1591, August 11 2026) does not solve DCP. We show that after the subset-sum measurement, this algorithm can be implemented (up to exponentially-small error) using only the most-significant third of the Fourier labels, and is therefore subject to our general no-go theorem. To help with verifiability, we release Lean 4 code for our results.
title_cn: 二面体陪集算法的 Fourier 标签信息损失障碍
abstract_cn: 我们为一大类针对二面体陪集问题（DCP）的量子算法建立了一个不可行定理。我们考虑 Regev（SIAM Journal on Computing，2004）提出的 Fourier 采样与子集和测量框架，这是求解 DCP 的主要方法之一。假设在测量子集和的低 n-1 位之后，算法从每个 Fourier 标签中丢弃任意 ω(log n) 位，则我们证明该算法不能成功求解 DCP。这表明任何遵循此框架的算法都必须充分利用 Fourier 标签，从而为开发 DCP 算法提供了有益的指导。作为主要应用，我们证明 Simon（IACR ePrint:2026/1591，2026 年 8 月 11 日）的近期算法不能求解 DCP。我们证明，在子集和测量之后，该算法仅使用 Fourier 标签中最高有效的三分之一部分即可实现（误差至多为指数级小量），因此受我们一般不可行定理的约束。为便于验证，我们公开了我们结果的 Lean 4 代码。
summary_cn: 对 Regev 2004 式二面体陪集问题算法建立不可行结果：若子和测量后从每个傅里叶标签丢弃 ω(log n) 比特，就无法求解 DCP；并由此证明 Simon（IACR ePrint 2026/1591）的最新算法可约化为仅用最高位三分之一的傅里叶标签，因此落入该不可行定理，不能解决 DCP；配套发布 Lean 4 证明代码。
objective_summary: 论文在 Regev 模板下证明丢弃 ω(log n) 比特傅里叶标签即无法解决 DCP，并把 Simon 的新算法归约到该框架以证伪其求解主张，附 Lean 4 代码。
evidence_note: 摘要给出一般不可行定理与对 Simon 算法的具体归约（指数小误差内），并附 Lean 4 形式化代码。
novelty_note: 针对 Regev 式 DCP 算法家族给出傅里叶标签信息损失屏障，并用它反驳 Simon 2026 的求解声明。
scope: 结论限于 Regev 2004 提出的傅里叶采样与子和测量模板下的 DCP 算法。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；只对符合 Regev 模板的算法成立，未排除其它算法路线。

title: Verifiable quantum advantage based on polynomials with planted structures
abstract: A central question in the theory of quantum advantage is whether there are quantum advantage protocols with similar resource requirements as random circuit sampling that are also verifiable just from the classical outputs of the quantum computation. Here, we develop the idea of simulation secrets for verifiable advantage. A verifier can use a simulation secret to evaluate a cross-entropy test faster than it would take a classical adversary to pass the test. We instantiate this idea using IQP circuits described by cubic polynomials with planted independent spaces. These correspond to the largest independent set in the orbit of a polynomial under the general linear group and yield a low-rank stabilizer decomposition of the corresponding state. We conjecture that large independent spaces are invisible to a computationally bounded adversary, and therefore they cannot exploit them to pass the protocol. A second conjecture regards the fine-grained complexity of producing samples that pass the cross-entropy test for uniformly random polynomials. Under these conjectures, our scheme results in a polynomial gap between the verification time and the time a classical adversary would need to pass the protocol---both are exponential. It has a potential application to generating classically certifiable randomness, since the output distributions have high min-entropy. We estimate that the planted polynomial scheme is implementable using 100 logical qubits at logical error rates around $10^{-6}$.
comment: 44 pages, 1 figure. Comments welcome
title_cn: 基于植入结构多项式的可验证量子优势
abstract_cn: 量子优势理论的核心问题之一是：是否存在资源需求与随机电路采样相近、且仅凭量子计算的经典输出即可验证的量子优势协议。本文提出了用于可验证优势的「模拟秘密」这一思想。验证者可利用模拟秘密，以比经典对手通过测试所需时间更快的速度完成交叉熵测试的评估。我们使用由带有植入独立空间的三次多项式描述的 IQP 电路来实例化这一思想。这些独立空间对应于多项式在一般线性群作用下轨道中的最大独立集，并给出对应态的低秩稳定子分解。我们猜测，大型独立空间对计算受限的对手是不可见的，因此对手无法利用它们来通过协议。第二个猜想涉及对均匀随机多项式生成能通过交叉熵测试的样本的细粒度复杂度。在这些猜想成立的前提下，我们的方案在验证时间与经典对手通过协议所需时间之间产生了多项式级差距——两者均为指数级。该方案具有生成经典可认证随机数的潜在应用价值，因为输出分布具有较高的最小熵。我们估计，植入多项式方案可使用 100 个逻辑量子比特、在逻辑错误率约为 10^(-6) 的条件下实现。
summary_cn: 提出用「模拟秘密」实现可验证量子优势：以带有植入独立子空间的三次多项式刻画 IQP 电路，使得对应态具有低秩稳定子分解；在两条猜想下得到验证时间与经典对手通过协议所需时间之间的多项式差距（两者都指数），并估计方案可用 100 逻辑比特、10^-6 逻辑错误率实现。
objective_summary: 论文把带植入独立空间的三次多项式嵌入 IQP 电路，用模拟秘密加速交叉熵测试的验证，并对实现规模给出资源估计。
evidence_note: 方案依赖两条未证明的猜想，摘要未报告实际硬件实验，仅给出 100 逻辑比特、10^-6 错误率的估计。
novelty_note: 引入模拟秘密概念并以带植入独立空间的多项式实例化 IQP 电路，为验证型量子优势给出新路线。
scope: 适用于带植入独立子空间的 IQP 电路采样协议，验证通过交叉熵测试进行。
limitations: 安全性与硬度结论建立在两条未证猜想之上，尚未经硬件实现。

title: CodeMimicry: Exploiting Safety Generalization Lag in Large Language Models via Structured Code Completion
abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable capabilities across diverse domains, yet their safety alignment remains vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. In this work, we identify a previously underexplored failure mode - safety generalization lag - where alignment trained predominantly on natural language fails to transfer to the code domain. We show that this lag induces a code-completion blind spot, allowing malicious intent embedded within syntactically valid code to evade safety mechanisms. To exploit this vulnerability, we propose CodeMimicry, a fully automated black-box jailbreak framework that generates structured, object-oriented code prompts to induce harmful outputs via code completion. Experiments on 8 state-of-the-art commercial LLMs demonstrate that CodeMimicry achieves a 96.25% attack success rate with 1.51 queries on average, significantly outperforming both template-based and optimization-based baselines. Beyond empirical performance, we provide a mechanistic analysis of code-based jailbreaks through latent space representations, including projection onto refusal-related directions and activation steering. This analysis offers an explanation of how CodeMimicry bypasses safety mechanisms in code-related domains. Our findings reveal a weakness in current safety alignment and highlight the need for robust alignments in structured domains such as code.
comment: This paper will be accepted at NeurIPS 2026
title_cn: CodeMimicry：通过结构化代码补全利用大语言模型的安全泛化滞后
abstract_cn: 大语言模型在多个领域取得了卓越能力，但其安全对齐仍易受越狱攻击。本文识别出一种此前鲜被探索的失效模式——安全泛化滞后——即主要在自然语言上训练的对齐无法迁移到代码领域。我们证明这种滞后导致了代码补全盲区，使嵌入语法合法代码中的恶意意图得以规避安全机制。为利用这一漏洞，我们提出 CodeMimicry，一种全自动黑盒越狱框架，通过生成结构化的面向对象代码提示，经由代码补全诱导有害输出。在 8 个最先进的商用大语言模型上的实验表明，CodeMimicry 平均仅需 1.51 次查询即可达到 96.25% 的攻击成功率，显著优于基于模板和基于优化的基线方法。超越实证性能，我们通过潜在空间表示对基于代码的越狱进行机制分析，包括向拒绝相关方向的投影与激活引导。该分析提供了 CodeMimicry 如何在代码相关领域绕过安全机制的解释。我们的发现揭示了当前安全对齐的一个弱点，并强调了在代码等结构化领域实现鲁棒对齐的必要性。
summary_cn: 识别出大模型在代码域存在「安全泛化滞后」的失败模式，提出全自动黑盒越狱 CodeMimicry：以结构化面向对象代码提示诱导补全出有害内容；在 8 个商用 LLM 上平均 1.51 次查询取得 96.25% 成功率，并以潜空间投影与激活引导给出机制解释（NeurIPS 2026）。
objective_summary: 论文构造以代码补全为载体的越狱框架，并在 8 个商用 LLM 上与模板型及基于优化的基线对比攻击成功率与查询次数，再用潜空间与激活分析解释机制。
evidence_note: 覆盖 8 个商用 LLM，含模板型与优化型两类基线对比，并补充潜空间投影与激活引导分析；摘要未给统计检验。
novelty_note: 将代码域的安全对齐缺口形式化为「安全泛化滞后」，并以结构化代码补全作为统一黑盒越狱手段。
scope: 针对 8 个商用大语言模型，威胁模型为无需白盒访问的结构化代码提示黑盒攻击。
limitations: 摘要未讨论局限；仅在 8 个商用模型上评估，未覆盖开放权重模型或非代码域对比。

title: PassGPT+: Leveraging Linguistic Priors for Password Modeling
abstract: Passwords remain the dominant online authentication mechanism, and understanding how humans choose them is essential for defensive strength estimation and attack simulation alike. Recent learning-based approaches such as PassGAN and PassGPT have shown that deep generative models can learn password structure directly from leaked corpora. However, both train from random initialization on password data alone. The role of linguistic prior knowledge in password modeling, and what it reveals about how humans create secrets, remains largely underexplored. Here, we address this gap with PassGPT+, which adapts the linguistic prior of GPT-2 to password observations through character-aware tokenization. We also introduce PassDiffusion, the first absorbing-state discrete diffusion model for password generation, as a probe of whether non-autoregressive approaches are competitive. On the RockYou benchmark, PassGPT+ recovers 22.53% of held-out passwords at 108 guesses, a 16% relative gain over PassGPT, and retains 79% of this match rate when transferred without retraining to a disjoint 2020 leak dataset, demonstrating that linguistic priors capture persistent regularities of human password generation. PassDiffusion underperforms by two to three orders of magnitude, indicating that autoregressive modeling is substantially better matched than iterative denoising to the discrete, exact-match nature of password generation.
